Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.
Lifting
Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.
Carrying
Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.
Crouching/Squatting
Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.
Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.
Climbing
During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Delivery Expert(05787) - 50 Surrey Plz
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers .the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

An attempt has been made to cover all responsibilites, but on occassion, duties may be required that were not listed in this description

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking Data Center Technicians as part of our Work Based Learning Program (WBLP).  This trainee position requires the successful candidate report to a site location.  Amazon has multiple WBLP trainee openings between January and December of 2027.

Physical Requirements (reasonable accommodations available):

NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide immigration sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Persons (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

Once in role, Technicians are required to complete a rigorous company training program and satisfy all registration, licensing, and certification requirements according to their State’s Board of Pharmacy guidelines. Until the Pharmacy Technician has completed all necessary requirements, duties may be restricted by the Pharmacy Manager.

A Technician is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

• Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists manage and improve patient health
• Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
• Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
• Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.

Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
• Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

• Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines

Meet the Team

The Network Engineering group is at the forefront of building the software platforms that power some of the largest networks in the world. The networking industry is undergoing a major transformation as next-generation infrastructure is developed to support rapidly growing AI/ML workloads and the ever-increasing number of internet users, applications, and services.

Our team helps redefine how networking and platform security problems are solved. You will develop security solutions for next-generation networking platforms while creating AI-powered systems that can reason, troubleshoot, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, platform security, networking, and AI/ML to deliver transformative tools for large-scale systems.

You will work alongside engineers who are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and building large-scale distributed systems. The team operates in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where engineers take ownership across the full product lifecycle — from development and testing through production support.

Your Impact

Join the Infrastructure Engineering team as a Software Engineer and help redefine how networking problems are solved. You will develop innovative software for next-generation networking platforms and create AI-powered systems that can reason, troubleshoot, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, networking, and AI/ML to deliver transformative tools for large-scale systems. In this role, you will:

• Design, develop, and test software for high-impact networking platforms and distributed systems.

• Collaborate with system architects and engineering teams to design scalable solutions that meet product requirements.

• Build systems and applications using modern development practices and open-source technologies.

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of complex software projects with an automation-first mindset.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize distributed systems to improve performance and reliability.

• Support production environments and participate in resolving real-world operational challenges.

• Work closely with geographically distributed engineering teams in a collaborative environment.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree +7 years of related experience, or Masters +4 years of related experience, or PhD +1 year of related experience, or equivalent related work experience.

• Programming experience in C/C++ & Python required.

• Experience with AI-driven workflows and Agentic frameworks.

• Understanding of foundational AI concepts and machine learning algorithms.

• Experience working with Linux systems, networking fundamentals, operating system concepts, and container-based applications.

• Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, or Devin

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience developing software for distributed systems or large-scale software platforms

• Certifications in AI/ML and Agentic workflows or equivalent.

• Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, routing protocols, and switching

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
Job Posting End Date

11-16-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date

Job Summary

Perform work involved with the installation, rearrangement, maintenance, operation, removal, and inspection of electrical transmission and distribution facilities, drive and operate line trucks and associated auxiliary equipment. All job duties apply to overhead and underground equipment and facilities. The Line Mechanic C builds upon the skills, abilities and knowledge learned as a Line Mechanic D (or equivalent).

Job Description

**The successful candidate must live (or be willing to relocate at their own expense) within 45 minutes safe driving distance of the Beckley Service Center (4600 Robert C Byrd Dr Beckley, WV 25801)

What You’ll Do:

• Assemble, install, maintain, inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and remove overhead and underground electrical distribution facilities and associated equipment.
• Perform work on energized and de-energized conductors, cables, transformers, switches, reclosers, and other electrical equipment in accordance with training, qualifications, and safety requirements.
• Test, de-energize, ground, splice, terminate, troubleshoot, repair, and energize Underground Residential Distribution (URD) cable and equipment.
• Install, maintain, and operate cutouts, line switches, sectionalizing devices, regulators, capacitor banks, transformer banks, and street lighting systems.
• Perform switching activities and follow established tagging, clearance, and safety procedures.
• Install, maintain, switch, and troubleshoot residential and commercial underground distribution systems.
• Locate and correct faults, hazardous conditions, and service interruptions using testing and diagnostic equipment.
• Interpret drawings, specifications, and standards to perform construction, maintenance, restoration, and live-line work.
• Operate and maintain company vehicles, aerial devices, line tools, and specialized equipment used in electric utility operations.
• Direct and assist employees assigned to support work activities and field operations.
• Communicate with customers regarding service requirements, outages, meter locations, and restoration activities.
• Maintain accurate records, reports, and apprenticeship documentation as required.
• Promote and support AEP's Accident Prevention, Safety and Health, and Corporate Compliance programs.
• Perform similar or less-skilled work and assume other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Note: This position is posted at multiple grade levels and offers a range of opportunities for advancement. The minimum qualifications outlined below vary by classification level, with increased experience, training, certifications, and responsibilities required for higher-level Line Mechanics.

What We're Looking For:

Education requirements are listed below:

• High school diploma or GED.

Work Experience requirements are listed below:

• Line Mechanic C: Minimum one year of distribution electrical power line work experience, or qualifying electrical line school education and internship experience as defined by the Company.
• Line Mechanic B: Minimum two years of work experience as a Line Mechanic C or equivalent experience as determined by the Company.
• Line Mechanic A: Successful completion of apprentice lineman training, including required certifications and demonstrations, or a minimum of four years of line work experience and successful completion of the journeyman pre-assessment.

Licenses/Certifications:

• Valid Class A Commercial Driver's License (CDL) is required.

Other:

• Must have demonstrated qualifications equivalent to the preceding classification level and successfully qualify through demonstration, examination, and/or performance appraisal as determined by the Company.
• Must have the ability and desire to acquire the necessary knowledge and skills to advance through the Line Mechanic progression.
• Must obtain qualifications required for advancement within Company-established timeframes.
• A Physical Abilities Assessment (PAT) is required for this position.
• Must be able to safely perform work on overhead and underground electric utility facilities.
• Must be capable of working outdoors in varying weather conditions and responding to emergency restoration situations.
• Must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, teamwork, customer service, and operational excellence.

What You’ll Get: In addition to a competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

When you join Gartner, you'll be a part of a team that serves thousands of business and technology leaders at global conferences each year. You’ll work with curious, motivated people, have unlimited career development opportunities, and stay at the cutting edge of technology, business, and AI-driven transformation. If you enjoy challenging yourself, connecting with people and pushing the limits of your career, Gartner is the place for you.

As an Account Executive (B2B Sales) at Gartner Conferences, you will drive full-cycle sales within a portfolio of enterprise (Fortune 500) accounts. You’ll partner with senior executives to align Gartner’s world-class conferences with their mission-critical business priorities, while managing pipeline, generating demand, and closing opportunities.

This is a quota-carrying sales role focused on revenue growth, client retention, and new business development.

What You'll Get

• Unlimited earning potential through a competitive base salary, uncapped commissions, and additional bonuses
• Merit-based compensation growth with opportunities for salary increases tied to performance
• Clear path for career advancement with defined progression into senior sales roles
• Hybrid work environment to support flexibility
• Virtual selling environment - limited travel to Conferences
• World-class sales training, coaching, and mentorship
• Recognition for top performers, including all-inclusive incentive trips and awards
• Complimentary daily breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages provide onsite

• 20 days of PTO plus company-paid holidays, with additional PTO growth over tenure
• $500 annual WellBeing Fund to support fitness, wellness, home office expenses, and more
• Up to $5,250 annually in tuition reimbursement to support your continued professional development
• Mental health and well-being resources, including free coaching and therapy support
• Industry-leading family support benefits, including parental leave, caregiver resources, backup childcare, and adoption/surrogacy assistance

What You’ll Do

• Execute full-cycle sales: prospecting, outreach, pipeline management, and closing
• Generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, and account expansion
• Consistently meet or exceed quota through client retention, upselling, and new business
• Build and maintain relationships with senior-level executives across enterprise accounts
• Collaborate cross-functionally with internal sales and account teams to drive revenue
• Identify new stakeholders and expand buying groups within named accounts
• Advise clients on the best conference solutions to support business objectives

What You’ll Need

• 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management
• 3+ years of professional working experience
• Experience in a quota-driven, fast-paced sales environment
• Demonstrated success with prospecting, pipeline generation, or closing deals
• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills
• Ability to build trust-based relationships with senior executives

• Self-starter mindset with ability to work both independently and collaboratively

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Analyst – Cybersecurity Executive Product Management
jobs.description:
About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have research, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner and within their industry, making them a trusted source of advice for clients. As the market expert, a Sr. Director not only produces innovative, pragmatic and provocative research content, but also serves as a decisionmaker and leader of Gartner cross team and cross practice research initiatives. They also engage with clients directly through virtual and in-person consultations, meetings, conferences and industry events. Through these engagements, they challenge clients to reframe their thinking across key initiatives, interpret contextual realities and propose new ways to obtain data to diagnose and/or solve complex problems, improve client performance, and most importantly provide actionable strategic insights.

What You’ll Do:

In your role as Sr. Dir. Analyst for High Tech (HT) Cybersecurity, you will be primarily responsible for leading and advising Gartner clients by researching cybersecurity across a range cyber security services capabilities along with thoughtful insight on building continuity across products, services and vendors.  Beyond just research you will apply business acumen to driving insight which will have impact to P&L, go to market activities and the applicability of C-level insights needed to drive product and service strategies.

You will be charged with creating and delivering HT strategic and tactical advice and research content which guides CPOs, Product Leaders, and Product Managers on critical current and future cybersecurity services and the execution of those services as the apply to emerging technologies based on new AI operating models through written research reports, presentations, teleconferences, inquiries, and briefings.  During each research project, you will work closely with adjacent covering analysts, and service delivery associates across Gartner, to deliver a world-class experience for our technology provider membership subscribers.

• As a thought leader, develop new research and ideas and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs.
• Conduct innovative, fact-based, “must-have research” and analysis around clients’ key initiatives.
• Participate and conduct “case-based research” (an ETT methodology) by speaking with senior executives, academics, industry experts, etc. and conducting wide-ranging secondary literature searches.
• Create highly synthesized content that can be leveraged and/or contextualized across the functions and roles that Gartner serves
• Provide clients, vendors and prospects with actionable advice on complex questions, challenges or circumstances
• Proactively support Consultation, Client Engagement Services (CES), Sales and Service and other internal stakeholders across relevant research key initiatives to help clients and prospects
• As an industry leader, represent Gartner research, methodology, and strategy
• Create and deliver high value presentations on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings targeting senior level executives
• Research, analyze and predict expected (and foresee unexpected) market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
• Use creative and innovative analytical or diagnostic approaches; leverage less obvious synergies and encourage colleagues to find and consider alternate interpretations of information
• Lead and influence internal projects, special roles and processes driving decisions on highly complex issues to create the best research and advice, and optimize Gartner's business
• Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner research and interactions
• Work independently and in collaboration with other Gartner associates to improve research deliverables and support the performance of Gartner in chosen markets Be a mentor, connector, leader and coach to team members

What you will need:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent
• 15+ years of relevant field or industry experience
• Prior experience as a Service Delivery Leader/Manager, Consulting Practice Leader/Manager, or in an Executive Product Leadership capacity with AI related solutions.
• Prior experience working for a large cybersecurity solutions/services company or large organizations implemented, integrating and/or leveraging AI capabilities.
• Prior Profit & Loss ownership
• Recognized industry expert and thought leader
• Knowledge of the global and competitive landscape, and the interplay in that landscape
• Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
• Accomplished in public speaking, presentation creation and delivery
• Proven ability to develop new business development opportunities
• Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts both concisely and simply
• Have deep competitor and market expertise
• Skillfully adapt to change and navigate a highly matrixed environment
• Great team player and must have intrinsic motivation to work with peers to write provocative and pragmatic research notes
• Ability to influence, challenge and reframe client thinking
• Availability to periodically travel, regionally and globally

jobs.title: Communications Manager - Sales
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced communications professional who enjoys working with senior leaders, simplifying complex information, and helping employees feel connected to the business?

Gartner is seeking a Manager, Global Business Sales Communications, to help inform, engage and inspire associates across our Global Business Sales organization. In this role, you will partner with sales leaders and communications colleagues to create clear, compelling communications that support business priorities and help our teams succeed.

This is an opportunity to join a high-performing, collaborative team and play an important role in how we connect thousands of sales associates and leaders to Gartner’s strategy, priorities, and success.

The role reports to the Senior Director, Global Business Sales Communications.

What You’ll Do:

• Create and support a range of communications, including town hall segments, executive presentations, video scripts, intranet announcements, and other employee communications.

• Partner with sales leaders to understand their communication needs and provide thoughtful, practical guidance.

• Help develop communications and resources for important sales programs, including manager meetings, conference-related initiatives, and AI-related client success stories.

• Support communications for key Global Business Sales priorities, projects and business updates.

• Develop engaging videos and other multimedia content for associates, working with Gartner’s creative and production teams.

• Coordinate with internal specialist teams on communications projects, helping clarify goals, provide feedback, and keep work moving forward.

• Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-moving environment while maintaining a high standard of quality.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Global Business Sales, Sales and Services Communications, Marketing and Finance to prioritize content and deliver communications that support the broader business strategy.

• Look for opportunities to improve how we communicate, share information, and engage our sales teams.

Why This Role:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Work closely with senior leaders and help shape communications for a high-impact global sales organization.

• Turn business priorities into communications that employees can understand and act on.

• Build relationships across teams and gain broad exposure to Gartner’s business.

• Contribute to high-visibility communications, including executive messaging, town halls, videos, and major business initiatives.

• Join a team that values thoughtful partnership, creativity, strong writing, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring:

• Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in internal, corporate, or executive communications.

• A bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, or related field is preferred.

• Experience supporting sales or other customer-facing teams is preferred.

• Excellent writing, editing, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and engaging.

• Experience creating or supporting multimedia content, including video, presentations, or digital communications.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to work with senior leaders and a range of stakeholders.

• Excellent organization and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and adapt when business needs change.

• A collaborative, proactive approach and a willingness to learn.

• Creativity, curiosity, and sound judgment.

• Experience using Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Word, as well as web-based content management tools.

• Must be located within a 60-minute commuting distance of Stamford, Connecticut (NYC metro area).

jobs.title: Senior Director, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Sr Director, Customer Success

Lead the customer success organization responsible for strengthening retention, accelerating growth, and helping Genesys customers realize measurable value from their customer experience investments. As Senior Director, Customer Success, you will lead and develop a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for a portfolio representing more than $100 million in annual recurring revenue, with executive accountability for customer outcomes, adoption, renewal, expansion, and advocacy.

You will shape customer success strategy across complex enterprise relationships, coach your team to translate customer priorities into actionable Customer Success Plans, and provide executive oversight for high-value opportunities and risks. Your leadership will help customers increase adoption of Genesys products and services while identifying opportunities to expand the Genesys CX portfolio through cross-sell and upsell strategies.

Working closely with senior leaders across Genesys, you will drive alignment across the customer journey and establish clear accountability between Customer Success and adjacent functions. This role offers significant visibility across the business and the opportunity to influence customer success practices, leadership capability, and enterprise customer strategy at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for a portfolio of enterprise customers, establishing a consistent success management approach that strengthens customer outcomes, retention, and sustainable growth
• Drive renewal, retention, cross-sell, and upsell performance by coaching the team to identify customer needs, demonstrate business value, and develop strategic expansion opportunities
• Coach Customer Success Managers to understand customers' business value drivers, success criteria, and key performance indicators, translating those insights into actionable Customer Success Plans
• Accelerate customer adoption and value realization by guiding customers toward the Genesys products, services, capabilities, and best practices most relevant to their business outcomes
• Strengthen executive customer relationships by providing strategic oversight for complex engagements and helping the team navigate senior decision makers and stakeholders
• Develop leadership and customer success capability through regular talent reviews, coaching, performance management, career development, and succession planning
• Expand customer advocacy by enabling the team to build referenceable relationships and increase participation in Customer Advisory Boards, customer roundtables, and other strategic engagement programs
• Mitigate customer risk by establishing proactive approaches to customer sentiment, identifying emerging concerns early, and converting risk into opportunities to strengthen relationships, retention, and growth
• Influence strategy across the customer journey by partnering with leaders in Sales, Services, Support, Product, and other functions to clarify roles, accountability, and coordinated customer engagement
• Champion an empathetic, collaborative leadership culture that enables teams to work across organizational boundaries while maintaining clear accountability for customer and business outcomes

AI Expertise & Advisory (Priority Focus)

• Be the customer’s trusted AI advisor: Translate AI concepts—generative and predictive AI, virtual agents, agent assist, conversation and journey analytics, and workflow automation—into clear business use cases, value hypotheses, and measurable outcomes for customer executives.
• Demonstrate deep, current knowledge of AI in our industry: Stay ahead of developments in AI for CX and CCaaS, including emerging use cases, the competitive landscape, responsible AI, governance, and data privacy considerations, and bring that perspective proactively to customers and internal teams.
• Use AI every day and model it for others: Apply AI tools in account analysis, planning, executive preparation, and daily productivity, and coach customers and teammates on practical ways to do the same.
• Identify and prioritize AI use cases: Partner with customers to uncover the AI opportunities with the highest business impact (e.g., containment, handle time, CSAT, agent productivity, cost to serve), build the business case, and define success measures.
• Drive AI adoption and consumption: Own the plan to move AI capabilities from purchased to deployed to actively consumed, tracking AI usage and token utilization and connecting results to renewal and expansion outcomes.

Adoption Motion (Priority Focus)

• Own the adoption motion end to end: Lead the customer from onboarding and go-live through value realization, sustained usage, and renewal or expansion, with clear accountability at each stage.
• Define adoption success up front: Establish baselines, target outcomes, and measurable adoption milestones (e.g., time to first value, license and feature utilization, AI consumption) within each Customer Success Plan, aligned to the customer’s business objectives.
• Run a structured, repeatable cadence: Hold regular adoption working sessions, health reviews, and EBRs with defined owners, actions, and timelines, and escalate blockers early.
• Diagnose and close adoption gaps: Analyze usage, consumption, and health data (e.g., Gainsight and platform telemetry) to identify under-utilized capabilities, stalled deployments, and at-risk accounts, then build and execute targeted recovery plans well ahead of renewal.
• Drive customer enablement and change management: Equip customer stakeholders through training, enablement, champions, and executive sponsorship so new capabilities are embraced by end users, not just deployed.
• Orchestrate internal resources: Align Onboarding, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales, and Renewal Managers behind a single adoption plan and remove obstacles to progress.
• Measure and report: Track leading indicators and outcomes of adoption, report progress to customers and leadership, and tie adoption results directly to renewal forecasts and expansion opportunities.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience leading Customer Success teams in a SaaS environment, including experience managing teams of 10 or more Customer Success Managers
• 8+ years of experience developing and managing relationships with executives and decision makers in complex customer environments
• Demonstrated success leading Customer Success organizations responsible for more than $100 million in annual recurring revenue
• Substantial hands-on experience as a Customer Success Manager within a high-growth SaaS organization
• Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in a technology-related or business-related field
• Strong knowledge of customer experience technologies and the CX industry, with the ability to lead consultative, value-focused customer conversations
• Proven track record of building collaborative, high-performing teams and developing customer success talent
• Demonstrated ability to lead effectively through change, complexity, and evolving business priorities
• Excellent executive communication, interpersonal, presentation, and written communication skills
• Strong leadership presence with demonstrated ability to influence, align, and motivate cross-functional teams with empathy and accountability
• Experience identifying opportunities to expand the reach and business value of a CX technology portfolio across the customer journey

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience developing customer success strategies that improve product adoption, retention, expansion, and customer advocacy across large enterprise portfolios
• Strong proficiency with Salesforce, Gainsight, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, online communities, and relevant customer engagement platforms
• Experience partnering with senior leaders across Sales, Services, Support, Product, and other functions to improve enterprise customer outcomes
• Familiarity with cloud-based CX platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, and evolving technologies shaping modern customer experience strategies

Benefits That Support You:
We invest in your well-being, because when you’re at your best, so are the experiences you create.

• Comprehensive extended group health coverage
• Generous paid time off, including vacation and personal leave
• Retirement savings program with employer RRSP matching up to a prescribed maximum amount
• Family-friendly benefits, including parental leave top-up and adoption assistance
• Growth and development opportunities through access to learning resources and internal mobility programs

Exact details of these programs, including the conditions for eligibility, the amount of the benefit (including caps on benefits and customary pricing details), the length of the paid time off, etc. will be provided upon hire and is subject to Genesys policies.

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$191,500.00 - 251,400.00

Working at Genesys

• AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
• A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
• Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
• Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
• Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.

What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

• Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.

• A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.

• Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.

• We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.

• After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.

Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Get notified about relevant opportunities.

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.

Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.

This is an active opening at Genesys. We use Artificial Intelligence to support the hiring process, but every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team, looking beyond keywords to focus on your experience and potential.

About Genesys:

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Description

Job Description

Job Title: Machine Operator - Night Shift

Location: Topeka, KS (Mars Petcare)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

---

Mars is looking to hire a highly motivated Machine Operator for our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant in Topeka, Kansas.

Whether you are an experienced manufacturing professional, someone looking to transition into a technical field, or a military Veteran transitioning to the civilian workforce, Mars offers the structured training, tools, and supportive team environment you need to build a long-term, rewarding career.

As a day shift Machine Operator, you will become a system expert in your assigned production area. You will be responsible for the safe, efficient operation of advanced equipment, ensuring our products meet the high standards our consumers and pets deserve.

---

What We Offer (Benefits & Perks)

· Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance starting on day one.

· Financial Security: Competitive base pay, annual performance-based bonus potential, and a highly competitive 401(k) company match.

· Work-Life Balance: Immediately eligible (based on hire date) for up to three weeks of paid vacation, 12 Paid Holidays per year, and Sick Pay.

· Family Support: Paid Maternity & Parental Leave, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability.

· Career Growth: Access to world-class technical training, clear pathways for promotion, and educational assistance.

---

Key Responsibilities

· Equipment Operation: Safely and efficiently operate food-safe machinery and production lines to meet daily operational targets.

· Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: Assess equipment operating reliability and perform routine technical repairs, adjustments, and root-cause troubleshooting.

· Preventative Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance tasks and partner with the specialized Maintenance team on complex equipment upkeep.

· Quality Assurance: Execute critical food safety and quality checks (e.g., metal detection, inspecting date codes, monitoring dump logs) and maintain a high level of product ownership.

· Detailed Record Keeping: Keep highly accurate logs and digital shift support documentation using basic desktop and production tracking computer systems.

· Material Handling: Safely operate a forklift to manage material flow and inventory control principles in your production area.

---

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

Minimum Qualifications:

· Education: High School diploma, GED, or equivalent civilian/military education.

· Physical Capability: Ability to stand on concrete floors for extended periods, bend, stoop, twist, turn, reach, climb stairs, and lift up to 50 lbs.

· Safety Mindset: Willingness to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including hair net, bump cap, ear plugs, safety shoes, and uniform.

· Certifications: Ability to obtain and maintain OSHA forklift certification (Mars will provide full on-site training and licensing).

Preferred Qualifications:

· Experience: 1+ years of manufacturing experience operating industrial machinery OR equivalent technical military experience (such as equipment maintenance, operations, or mechanical repairs).

· Technical Skills: Basic understanding of inventory control systems or experience utilizing enterprise asset management systems (e.g., SAP, GCSS, or equivalent databases).

---

Military & Veteran Technical Equivalency Guide

At Mars, we highly value your military service. If you served in any of the following fields (or a related occupational specialty), your military training maps directly to the technical, safety, and leadership demands of this role:

· U.S. Army: Allied Trade Specialist (91E), Wheeled Vehicle Repairer (91B), Motor Transport Operator (88M), Unit Supply Specialist (92Y), Horizontal Construction Engineer (12N).

· U.S. Navy: Machinist's Mate (MM), Machinery Repairman (MR), Engineman (EN), Equipment Operator (EO), Logistics Specialist (LS).

· U.S. Air Force: Aerospace Propulsion Specialist (2A6X1), Aircraft Metals Technology (2A7X1), Materiel Management (2S0X1), Pavements & Construction Equipment (3E2X1).

· U.S. Marine Corps: Machinist (2161), Metal Worker (1316), Engineer Equipment Operator (1345), Supply Chain/Logistics Specialist (3043), Motor Vehicle Operator (3531).

· U.S. Coast Guard: Machinery Technician (MK), Damage Controlman (DC), Storekeeper (SK).

About Mars, Incorporated

Mars is a family-owned business with more than a century of history making diverse products and offering services for people and the pets people love. With almost $35 billion in sales, the company is a global business that produces some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, UNCLE BEN’S®, and COCOAVIA®. Mars also provides veterinary health services that include BANFIELD® Pet Hospitals, Blue Pearl®, VCA® and Pet Partners™.

The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom – inspire our more than 100,000 Associates to create value for all its partners and deliver growth they are proud of every day.

jobs.title: LEAD: Field Eng I - 2027 Opportunities
jobs.description:
LEAD Field Engineer

Do you like working in collaborative teams and solving technical problems?

Would you like to work in the field with our customers?

Join the LEAD Field Engineer Development Program

The LEAD (Learn, Excel, Achieve, Develop) Field Engineer Development Program is a strategic, accelerated three and half year development program designed for recent engineering graduates seeking a career in Field Engineering. Through structured technical training, field experience, competency-based progression, coaching, and professional development, participants build the skills and experience required to perform in some of the most demanding operating environments in the energy industry. This program combines classroom learning, field execution, mentoring, and real-world customer operations to accelerate readiness for future technical and operational leadership opportunities.

Partner with the Best

As a LEAD Field Engineer, you will develop technical expertise by working alongside experienced engineers while supporting critical customer operations around the world. You will progress through defined competency stages that build capability, confidence, leadership skills, and operational readiness.

Over the three-and-a-half-year program, you will:

• Participate in structured technical bootcamps, on-the-job training, and competency-based development
• Execute field operations alongside experienced engineers in live operating environments
• Deploy, operate, troubleshoot, and maintain technical equipment and services
• Apply procedures and make decisions in dynamic, high-pressure situations
• Support customers and field crews during critical operations
• Coordinate with operational teams, service delivery personnel, and customers to ensure successful execution of work
• Develop problem-solving skills through hands-on troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, and system-level challenges
• Gain experience across multiple operational environments through travel and field assignments
• Participate in mentoring, job shadowing, cross-functional rotations, and developmental projects
• Progress through defined Field Engineer competency levels based on demonstrated capability, performance, and safety leadership
• Complete a capstone project and all required technical and professional milestones required for program graduation
• This role includes significant domestic and international travel, rotational schedules, non-standard work hours, and extended assignments at customer locations. Successful candidates must be comfortable working in unpredictable environments where safety, execution, and customer impact are paramount.

What You'll Gain

The LEAD Program provides:

• Structured technical training and field coaching
• Hands-on experience supporting high-intensity customer operations
• Exposure to global operations and diverse working environments
• Mentorship from experienced technical leaders
• Competency-based career progression
• Visibility to senior leaders and cross-functional teams
• Professional development, leadership development, and project experience
• Clear career pathways following program graduation
• Graduation from LEAD signifies successful completion of all required technical, professional, and developmental milestones. Graduates become eligible for advancement opportunities across the organization based on performance, business needs, and available openings.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

• Have graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (all disciplines) within the previous 12 months
• Have achieved a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 on a scale of 4.0 (or equivalent)
• Be fluent in written and spoken English, with excellent communication skills
• Demonstrate a strong interest in hands-on technical work and field operations
• Be willing to travel extensively and work rotational schedules
• Thrive in dynamic, fast-paced, and sometimes unpredictable environments
• Possess strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills
• Demonstrate leadership potential, learning agility, and a strong safety mindset
• Be motivated to continuously develop technical expertise and professional capabilities
• Be legally entitled to work within the country in which you are applying without sponsorship or time restrictions.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: FIELD ENG I - ALS

jobs.title: In-Home Traveler Physician (Full Time) - Idaho
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

THIS ROLE IS SIGN ON BONUS ELIGIBLE, ASK YOUR RECRUITER FOR MORE DETAILS!

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full-time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. Travel is required 85%–100% of the time, based on business needs, including frequent travel across multiple states. This may require overnight hotel stays, car rentals and/or flights, depending on the prescribed coverage area. Holding multiple state licenses will be required, as dictated by business needs.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In the traveler role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, up to 100% of the time
• Receive additional per-completion incentive pay for all in-home visits
• Conduct virtual visits as needed
• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health, dental and vision insurance
• Paid time off
• Annual CEU allowance
• 401K
• Supplies and other perks
• Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)
• Able to obtain and maintain multi-state licenses in coverage area, as required
• Able to cover the following primary locations: Able to cover all counties within Idaho and flex to other areas of business need

Please note: Our concierge-style Network Activation team will support you in obtaining, renewing, enrolling or verifying additional state licensure in new states (as business needs exist).

40

Full time

$174,070.00 - $374,920.00

Do you like working in collaborative teams and solving technical problems?

Join the LEAD Field Engineer Development Program

The LEAD (Learn, Excel, Achieve, Develop) Field Engineer Development Program is a strategic, accelerated three and half year development program designed for recent engineering graduates seeking a career in Field Engineering. Through structured technical training, field experience, competency-based progression, coaching, and professional development, participants build the skills and experience required to perform in some of the most demanding operating environments in the energy industry. This program combines classroom learning, field execution, mentoring, and real-world customer operations to accelerate readiness for future technical and operational leadership opportunities.

Partner with the Best

As a LEAD Field Engineer, you will develop technical expertise by working alongside experienced engineers while supporting critical customer operations around the world. You will progress through defined competency stages that build capability, confidence, leadership skills, and operational readiness.

Over the three-and-a-half-year program, you will:

• Participate in structured technical bootcamps, on-the-job training, and competency-based development

• Execute field operations alongside experienced engineers in live operating environments

• Deploy, operate, troubleshoot, and maintain technical equipment and services

• Apply procedures and make decisions in dynamic, high-pressure situations

• Support customers and field crews during critical operations

• Coordinate with operational teams, service delivery personnel, and customers to ensure successful execution of work

• Develop problem-solving skills through hands-on troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, and system-level challenges

• Gain experience across multiple operational environments through travel and field assignments

• Participate in mentoring, job shadowing, cross-functional rotations, and developmental projects

• Progress through defined Field Engineer competency levels based on demonstrated capability, performance, and safety leadership

• Complete a capstone project and all required technical and professional milestones required for program graduation

• This role includes significant domestic and international travel, rotational schedules, non-standard work hours, and extended assignments at customer locations. Successful candidates must be comfortable working in unpredictable environments where safety, execution, and customer impact are paramount.

What You'll Gain

The LEAD Program provides:

• Structured technical training and field coaching

• Hands-on experience supporting high-intensity customer operations

• Exposure to global operations and diverse working environments

• Mentorship from experienced technical leaders

• Competency-based career progression

• Visibility to senior leaders and cross-functional teams

• Professional development, leadership development, and project experience

• Clear career pathways following program graduation

• Graduation from LEAD signifies successful completion of all required technical, professional, and developmental milestones. Graduates become eligible for advancement opportunities across the organization based on performance, business needs, and available openings.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

• Have graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Petroleum and Chemical Engineering within the previous 12 months

• Have achieved a minimum cumulative CGPA of 7.5 on a scale of 10 (or equivalent)

• Be fluent in written and spoken English, with excellent communication skills

• Demonstrate a strong interest in hands-on technical work and field operations

• Be willing to travel extensively and work rotational schedules

• Thrive in dynamic, fast-paced, and sometimes unpredictable environments

• Possess strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills

• Demonstrate leadership potential, learning agility, and a strong safety mindset

• Be motivated to continuously develop technical expertise and professional capabilities

• Applicants must be authorized to work in the India and must maintain work authorization throughout their employment without requiring sponsorship by Baker Hughes, now or in the future

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: FIELD ENG I - WLE

jobs.title: Product Manager – Large Tabular Models
jobs.description:
PRODUCT MANAGER – LARGE TABULAR MODELS


LOCATION: MOUNTAIN VIEW, CA — DOWNTOWN HQ

Employment Type: Full-time
Work Model: On-site, 5 days/week
Department: Research




ABOUT GRANICA

Granica helps enterprises run AI for less, from the data layer to agent execution.

Granica is building across three related layers:

 - Crunch reduces storage and processing costs across enterprise data infrastructure.

 - Large Tabular Models unlock predictions and generated data from governed enterprise tables.

 - Myelin reduces token and compute overhead for long-running AI agents.

Everything runs inside the customer’s perimeter, so enterprises retain control of their data and the intelligence it creates.

Granica has already processed hundreds of petabytes of enterprise data in production for customers including Snap, Pinterest, Lyft, and ShareChat.

Our research organization is led by Stanford Professor Andrea Montanari.

We operate at the intersection of data infrastructure, AI systems, and applied research, building the efficiency and intelligence layer for enterprise AI.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Granica is hiring a Product Manager to turn Large Tabular Models into products that solve important enterprise problems.

This is a hands-on product role for someone with strong product judgment and unusual technical depth. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers, but your job is fundamentally product: identify the right problems, decide what to build, test hypotheses, learn from users, and turn emerging model capabilities into products customers adopt and pay for.

Experience with structured or tabular data is valuable, but not required. We are equally interested in exceptional PMs from AI products, search/retrieval, recommendation, ML platforms, developer tools, data infrastructure, and analytics.




THE MISSION

Most valuable enterprise data is structured, relational, private, and constantly changing.

Granica is building models that learn the underlying structure of enterprise data deeply enough to support many capabilities — including prediction, forecasting, anomaly detection, classification, imputation, synthetic data, and risk modeling.

The goal is to move beyond one model per task.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own product direction, roadmap, prioritization, and execution for Large Tabular Model products

 - Identify high-value customer problems where LTM capabilities create a meaningfully better solution

 - Work directly with customers to understand workflows, pain points, and adoption barriers

 - Partner with researchers and engineers to turn emerging model capabilities into product requirements and experiments

 - Build feedback loops across customer usage, product metrics, evaluations, and model improvements

 - Drive products from idea → prototype → launch → iteration

 - Translate technical improvements into measurable customer and economic value




WHAT MAKES THIS PROBLEM DIFFERENT

Structured enterprise data requires models to understand schemas, relationships, heterogeneous data types, distributions, temporal behavior, and business context.

The product challenge is determining which capabilities matter, for which users, and whether they are reliable enough to create real value.




EVALUATION IS A CORE PART OF THE PRODUCT

A benchmark score alone cannot tell us whether a model or product is useful.

We care about reliability, failure modes, generalization, real-world usage, and customer value. Evaluation is a core feedback mechanism for deciding what to build, improve, and launch.




SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of hands-on Product Management or equivalent product ownership

 - Track record of taking technically complex products from ambiguous problem to launch and iteration; ideally partnering with science / R&D organizations

 - Strong technical judgment and ability to work directly with researchers and engineers

 - Strong product judgment and customer orientation

 - Experience using metrics, experiments, evaluations, or product telemetry to guide decisions

 - Comfort operating in a highly technical 0→1 environment

 - Experience with AI/ML products, search/retrieval, developer platforms, data infrastructure, analytics, or other technically complex systems




ESPECIALLY VALUABLE

 - Experience with structured, relational, or tabular data

 - Experience building products on top of foundation models or other ML systems

 - Background in engineering, ML, data science, or another technical discipline

 - Ability to prototype directly using code, data, APIs, or AI tools

 - Strong enterprise and commercial instincts




IDEAL BACKGROUNDS

We are especially interested in hands-on PMs from:

 - AI products and model-powered applications

 - Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, or similar data platforms

 - OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, or similar AI organizations

 - Search, recommendation, ranking, forecasting, risk, fraud, or decision systems

 - Developer platforms, ML infrastructure, and technically complex APIs

We care much more about what you personally built and owned than your title.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Granica believes the next major enterprise AI breakthrough will come from learning much more deeply from the structured data that runs businesses.

This role will help determine which problems are worth solving, what the product becomes, how we know it works, and where emerging model capability creates real customer value.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and performance bonus for top performers

 - 401(k) with company match, comprehensive health coverage, and unlimited PTO

 - Daily catered meals in our Mountain View office

 - Support for research, publication, and conference participation



At Granica, you'll help build the next generation of enterprise AI—from exabyte-scale data infrastructure, Large Tabular Models (LTMs), and stateful AI agents. Together, we're creating the infrastructure that enables enterprises to own their data, own the intelligence built on it, and scale both efficiently.
