jobs.title: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer (NYC)
jobs.description:
Location: New York City (On-Site, 5 days) 



ABOUT KOMBO

Kombo is the unified API for ATS, HRIS, LMS and payroll systems. Instead of spending months building integrations one by one, companies integrate once with Kombo and connect to 200+ platforms instantly.

Since Y Combinator (S22), we've grown to 8-figures in revenue, 80+ team members, and raised $30M+ from YC, Volition Capital, and Acadian Ventures. We're tripling the team and revenue this year. And we move upmarket, with larger, more complex deals and sophisticated buying committees.



THE ROLE

We're hiring our US-based Pre-Sales Engineer to own the technical relationship with customers, from first sales call through successful implementation. The role is roughly 70% pre-sales / 30% post-sales, but the split is about time, not identity: We need someone who instinctively runs discovery and shapes deals, not someone who's comfortable in a technical conversation and happens to also do pre-sales.

You'll work closely with our Sales team, and our CRO to close deals and with Product/Engineering to turn customer insights into product improvements.

This is a builder role. You'll help grow our US GTM function and create the playbooks, while carrying deals yourself.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the technical sales cycle

 - Run technical discovery that uncovers the business objective behind a request, not just the request itself, including in domains we haven't fully mapped yet, where you'll need to hold credibility without pretending to have answers you don't

 - Create technical proposals covering architecture, security, and implementation approach

 - Partner with AEs on complex, multi-stakeholder deals with engineering and executive stakeholders

Drive implementations to go-live for complex projects

 - Own the technical relationship from POC through signed contract through production deployment

 - Create the supporting technical assets as you go: demo environments, Postman collections, integration guides, troubleshooting documentation
   

 Help Build the US Pre-Sales Function

 - Document repeatable playbooks for discovery, scoping, and implementation

 - Feed customer insight back to Product/Engineering in a way that shapes the roadmap without overpromising on it



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company, with genuine pre-sales ownership (discovery, champion-building, deal shaping) - not just implementation with some pre-sales overlap

 - Track record working complex deals with technical and non-technical stakeholders - consistent deal value of $100k-150k+

 - Strong communication skills: you can whiteboard architecture with engineers and translate value to executives

 - Hands-on with APIs - you can read documentation, ideally write sample code, and debug integration issues

 - Comfort with ambiguity and building things from scratch



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS

 - You've built and closed with at least one genuine technical champion in an enterprise account, not just a friendly technical contact

 - You've built real credibility with AEs and prospects in a domain (e.g. HRIS, ATS) you likely didn't know deeply on day one

 - You've built at least one reusable playbook, template, or asset (e.g. discovery framework, POC scoping doc, demo narrative) that other people on the team now use without you

 - You can point to your influence on ARR, deal velocity, or conversion

 - You're a trusted second read for AEs on deal strategy, and go far beyond just a technical resource they loop in when asked




HOW WE WORK

Ownership end-to-end. A customer isn't "handed off" when the contract is signed - you own the relationship from first technical call through successful go-live and beyond. Problems that surface in implementation are your problems to solve, not someone else's.

Written thinking. We use long-form documents to make decisions and share context. You'll write implementation plans, technical briefs, and customer-facing documentation that help the whole team move faster. If you prefer talking through everything in meetings, this isn't the right fit.

High-performance, high-support. We're a small team of people who are exceptional at what they do. Ex-founders, and operators who've built at scale before. We hold a high bar and give you the autonomy to meet it. We also celebrate wins together (roughly once a week for big releases, closings, or milestones).

Bias Towards Action, and high agency: We are building - if we need a resource, we create it. If a process needs improvement, we refine it. We take the initiative and ownership on everything we own, and don’t wait for permission.

In-person by default. We believe the best work happens together. This role is on-site in NYC 5 days per week.



NOT A FIT IF

 - You prefer fully remote work

 - You need extensive structure and hand-holding to be effective

 - Your instinct is to answer the question you were asked rather than find out why it's being asked in the first place

jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.description:
📍 NYC (On-site)

💲 $100,00-$140,000 + meaningful equity

⏰ Full-time

📌 Reports to: Head of Growth https://www.linkedin.com/in/madalina-tricolici/




TL;DR

Kombo (YC S22) builds the infrastructure layer for hire-to-retire employee data.
We power recruitment platforms, benefits providers, and spend management tools by giving them reliable access to candidate and employee data across any HRIS, LMS, ATS, or payroll system their customers use.

We're looking for Kombo's first Field Marketing Manager to turn conferences, events, executive dinners, and webinars into a repeatable pipeline engine.

This is a foundational role. You'll own events at Kombo end-to-end—from strategy to execution—and work directly with the CEO, CRO, Head of Growth, and cross-functional teams to make Kombo visible, credible, and trusted in our core markets.

If you've ever wanted to build an event motion from scratch at a high-growth company with room to scale into leadership, this is that role.




ABOUT KOMBO

Kombo is building the infrastructure layer for all people data. We’re a unified API for HR, payroll, LMS, and recruiting systems. Instead of integrating separately with dozens of platforms, companies integrate once with Kombo to access data from over 100 systems. We abstract away differences in data models, authentication, and API behavior.

Since going through Y Combinator in 2022, we:

 - Grew from 0 → $$XXM ARR+ (top ~5% growth-wise of VC-backed startups)

 - Scaled to 80+ team members across NYC 🇺🇸 and Berlin 🇩🇪

 - Raised $30M+ from Y Combinator, Acadian Ventures, 486 and other investors

Kombo is international by default. We sell globally, operate across regions, and build with a team representing 20+ nationalities.




THE ROLE

As Kombo's first Field Marketing Manager, you will lead our most important channel as we go up-market. You will own events strategy as a core GTM lever, tightly aligned with Sales, Business Development, and Product.

This role sits at the intersection of pipeline generation, brand, and relationships. You'll design experiences that create demand, accelerate deals, and strengthen Kombo's position as the go-to infrastructure partner in HR Tech.

You'll start hands-on and execution-heavy, with clear scope to grow into a lead role as our network-based GTM and events become a foundational pillar of our GTM motion.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

This role is perfect for you if you love owning events strategy and execution end to end, are a natural community-builder, and have excellent attention to detail. You'll build the field marketing playbook from zero and turn it into a predictable pipeline contributor. If you thrive with full ownership and love bringing people together, you’ll enjoy working here.


EVENTS OWNERSHIP (CORE RESPONSIBILITY)

 - Own all events at Kombo end to end, including:
   
   - Major industry conferences (e.g., HR Tech) where we sponsor
   
   - Executive dinners and roundtables (we have a V1 in place with lots of learnings here ready to 10x this year)
   
   - Roadshows and smaller field events
   
   - Webinars (operations and execution)

 - Plan events with leadership and own execution end-to-end

 - Identify the highest-impact places to reach our ICP and create a repeatable playbook for how we show up (format, setup, booth design, follow-up)


STRATEGIC AND OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Translate revenue targets and the product roadmap into a cohesive go-to-market plan, including conferences and events

 - Build and maintain our motion for in-person touch points selling ENT at scale

 - Continuously improve how we plan and execute events as volume increases


HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

 - Event-sourced and event-influenced pipeline (north star)

 - Attendance quality (ICP fit, seniority, intent)

 - Bird-eye view of key events, execution excellence, and on-time delivery

 - Repeatability and scalability of successful event formats


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong project manager who can run multiple initiatives in parallel with high standards

 - High ownership, high standards, and strong judgment

 - 1–5 years of experience in field marketing or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company

 - Commercial mindset with clear understanding of sales cycles and buyer journeys

 - Hands-on executor who enjoys being close to the work and traveling regularly

 - Curiosity and empathy to understand our buyer persona deeply (technical C-level execs) and design events backward from it

Nice to haves but not a must:

 - Proven track record of driving measurable pipeline through events

 - Experience marketing to technical or infrastructure buyers (CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Product)

 - Built a field marketing motion from scratch at an early-stage company


WHY JOIN KOMBO

 1. An ambitious growth path
    
    We've grown from $1M → $10M+ ARR in two years and are on track to double the team again in the next year. We already have good data points to believe events will be foundational to our GTM strategy up-market and this role can lead the way there with potential to develop into a Head of Marketing position.

 2. Build something from zero
    
    This is Kombo's first dedicated field marketing hire. You'll define the strategy, set the bar, and create the playbook.

 3. Direct impact on revenue
    
    Field marketing is a core GTM lever at Kombo. Your work will directly influence pipeline and deals, not sit on the sidelines.

 4. A high-caliber, kind, and ambitious team
    
    We aim to build a top 1% operating GTM team in tech. Our team is formed by former founders, professional athletes, or future founders - all fueled by intrinsic motivation to grow and learn as fast as possible. We inspire, encourage, and push each other to be better every day. If this is the environment you want to be part of, join us.

About Kombo

 - Grew from 0 to $XXM ARR and hundreds of customers (top ~5% of VC-backed startups by growth rate)

Angels include Paul Forster (founder of Indeed), Sultan Saidov (Beamery), Jean-Denis Grèze (Plaid), and Carsten Thoma (Celonis). 

See the team here. https://www.notion.so/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21



The role
Kombo is moving upmarket. Our sales motion is account-based, and Senior Enterprise BDRs own a small, focused book of our highest-potential accounts: Fortune 2000 companies and others where the deal size justifies a precise, strategic approach. Small book. Big impact.

You'll work tightly with AEs and leadership to develop account strategy, map stakeholders, and create pipeline that moves the business. ARR is our top metric company-wide, and the team is already hitting quota. You'll help push the standard higher from day one.

Paired with expected speed of learning and ownership, and you'll grow fast: AE in roughly 9-12 months is the most common next step, with paths into management, operations, expansion, and support opening up as we scale.

We win as a team, so you'll also work with people across the company, including the founders, to find the right approach to complex, high-value accounts. The role is thoughtful and focused, not automated or mindless.

Because of this, we don't micro-manage. We expect everyone here to own their role, including the people supporting you so you can hit your targets.



What you'll do
At any given time, only ~5% of your ICP is in market for our product. Your job is to figure out how to reach 100% of that 5%.

That means going deep on the product, our customers, and how they buy, then forming your own point of view on how to meet them where they are. You'll stay current on what's working in outbound, lean on our advisors and partners, and grow into a strong GTM operator. As one of the more experienced BDRs on the team, you'll also help onboard new hires and share what's working on accounts, sequencing, and messaging.



What we're looking for
A few traits we tend to see in BDRs who thrive here:

 - You have 1-2 years of outbound experience in B2B SaaS and have already learned what good looks like.

 - You're curious and humble, and you ask questions to really understand a customer before adjusting your angle.

 - You communicate clearly, in writing and on calls.

 - You take ownership of your work and figure things out with structured, independent thinking.

 - You have a bias toward action, and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for the perfect plan.

 - You're looking for the right company to make the jump to AE, not just any company.

 - You enjoy working in person with a team.
   
   

What we offer

 - Competitive base + variable comp, uncapped accelerators above quota

 - Clear path to AE in 9-12 months for strong performers, where your comp roughly doubles

 - Generous ESOP

 - Bi-annual team offsites and monthly team events

 - Direct access to senior mentors and advisors

We're aiming to 3x our team and revenue this year, so there's real room to grow.



Interview process

 1. 25-minute intro call

 2. 45-minute deep-dive on your background and the role with Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/taylor-j-peck/, Kombo's Business Development Lead

 3. 1.5-hour case study

 4. Lunch with the team you'd be working with

jobs.title: Part-Time Retail Ambassador - Bridgeport Village
jobs.description:
RETAIL AMBASSADOR - PART-TIME

Tigard, OR - Bridgeport Village

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - Previous retail or customer service experience preferred

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

 - Ability to stand/walk an entire shift

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Wellness and Commuter Programs

 - PTO and Wellbeing Time

 - Employee Discount Program

Please see our Privacy Policy here https://rothys.com/pages/privacy-policy

A family in New York, NY 10028 is seeking an encouraging, patient part-time tutor to provide one-on-one special education homework support for their 8-year-old child in second grade. The ideal candidate will help build confidence and comprehension in Math and ELA, pacing instruction to support the child’s language delay and unique learning style.

Schedule:

• Monday and Tuesday

• 5:30 PM – 8:00 PM (5 hours per week)

• Start Date: As soon as possible

Family Specifications:

• One-on-one, in-home learning environment

• Child is an 8-year-old second grader with high-functioning autism and a language delay who receives related services during the school day

• Family values an educator with a soft-spoken, warm, and positive approach

Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Program Director, Space Electromagnetic Warfare
jobs.description:
What Impact You’ll Have:

The Program Director owns end-to-end delivery of complex space electromagnetic warfare (EW) programs, from contract award through development, integration, test, deployment, and sustainment. This leader is accountable for cost, schedule, technical performance, and customer satisfaction across a multi-disciplinary portfolio. The portfolio consists of large, multi-year programs of record executed under formal acquisition governance. The program team numbers approximately 80-120 full-time staff. The position reports to the Business Unit General Manager and is primarily located in Dulles, VA. It will require roughly 25-35% travel to customer sites, supplier facilities, test ranges, and operational sites.

The role is the primary interface to government acquisition customers and the operational user community. It also aligns the supply chain and internal functions (engineering, contracts, finance, quality, security, and mission assurance) behind a single integrated plan, and builds and leads a high-performing program team.

What You’ll Own:

Program execution

• Own program cost, schedule, and technical baselines; deliver against contract requirements and protect program margin.

• Lead integrated program planning and control using the Integrated Master Plan and Integrated Master Schedule (IMP/IMS), Estimates at Completion (EACs), variance analysis, and corrective action.

• Drive the full lifecycle for terrestrial space EW systems and command & control (C2) systems: requirements, integration and test, environmental qualification, global deployment, delivery support, and operations.

• Deliver and sustain a large number of terrestrial space EW edge units to multiple Areas of Responsibility (AORs) simultaneously.

• Run disciplined risk, issue, and opportunity management; anticipate technical, schedule, and threat-driven changes.

• Manage changes in scope, engineering change proposals (ECPs), baseline change requests, and contract modifications with Contracts and Finance.

Supply chain

• Own the program supply chain strategy, including make/buy decisions, subcontract management, and critical-path procurement.

• Manage long-lead parts, obsolescence, and single-source risk.

• Hold suppliers accountable for cost, schedule, quality, and flow-down of security and mission assurance requirements.

• Mitigate counterfeit part, export control (ITAR), and supply chain security risks.

Acquisition customers

• Serve as the primary point of contact for government program offices.

• Lead program management reviews (PMRs), baseline reviews, milestone and technical reviews, and executive-level briefings.

• Build trust through transparent reporting, early escalation, and consistent delivery.

• Identify follow-on, scope-growth, and recompete opportunities; support capture and proposal efforts.

User community

• Lead teams engaging operational users (e.g., operator units, combatant commands, and support organizations) to understand mission needs and concepts of operation.

• Translate operational feedback into requirements, upgrades, and sustainment priorities.

• Support operational test, user training, fielding, and transition to operations.

• Integrate program efforts for community engagement and reporting with the Business Unit Mission Support Officer (MSO) to ensure a cohesive, consistent, and accurate status is understood by all external stakeholders.

Internal stakeholders

• Align engineering, manufacturing, contracts, finance, quality, mission assurance, security, and business development behind program priorities.

• Report program health and financial performance to executive leadership; secure resources and resolve cross-functional conflicts.

• Ensure compliance with company processes, security requirements (including classified data handling), and regulatory obligations.

Team leadership

• Build, lead, and develop a multi-disciplinary team of program managers, technical leads, engineers, schedulers, and analysts.

• Set clear goals, delegate ownership, and coach for performance; manage hiring, reviews, and succession.

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, safety, and mission focus.

What You Must Have:

• U.S. citizenship required, with the ability to obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI clearance

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.

• 12+ years in aerospace and defense, including 7+ years in program management leadership roles and 3+ years as program manager or deputy program manager for a large program of record.

• Demonstrated delivery of large, complex space or electromagnetic warfare programs, ideally space EW, SIGINT, or RF payloads, from development through launch or fielding.

• Experience leading large programs of record (ACAT I/II or equivalent) under DoD 5000-series or Intelligence Community (IC) acquisition governance (ICD 801), including milestone reviews and Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs).

• Full profit-and-loss accountability for programs of significant value (e.g., $50M+), with a track record of meeting cost and schedule commitments.

• Hands-on experience with earned value management (EIA-748), including EACs and variance analysis; IMS development; and FAR/DFARS contract types (cost-plus, fixed-price, and incentive).

• Experience managing subcontractors and hardware supply chains.

• Direct experience leading reviews and relationships with DoD or IC acquisition customers and operational users.

• Proven leadership of multi-disciplinary teams, including direct and matrixed staff.

What Would Be Nice to Have:

• Active TS/SCI clearance

• Master's degree in engineering, systems engineering, or business (MBA).

• PMP certification and/or DAWIA Program Management (Advanced) or equivalent.

• Background in EW techniques, RF systems, spectrum operations, or counterspace mission areas.

• Experience on Special Access Programs (SAP); current polygraph or willingness to undergo one.

• Experience leading a program through Milestone C, production, and transition to sustainment.

• Experience on programs under a validated Earned Value Management System (EVMS), including IBRs, IPMDAR/CPR reporting, and DCMA surveillance.

• Prior military service or government program office experience in a space or EW role.

• Experience growing a program portfolio through capture and recompete wins.

• Experience with Foreign Military Sales (FMS) cases and ITAR compliance.

Core competencies

• Strategic and operational leadership: sets direction and keeps execution on track.

• Stakeholder management: balances the needs of customers, users, suppliers, and executives.

• Technical fluency: credible with engineers on RF/signal processing, mission-critical software development, and hardware integration trades.

• Financial acumen: manages budgets, EACs, margins, and funding profiles.

• Program discipline: runs the program to its baselines, governance, and reporting cadence, and holds the team to them.

• Risk-based decision making: makes timely decisions with incomplete information, documents the rationale, and escalates early.

• Communication: delivers clear, concise briefings, from team stand-ups to senior government leaders.

• Talent development: builds strong teams and grows future program leaders.

Liquid AI is building the foundation for edge AI, and silicon providers, to emerging companies building the next generation of AI hardware, are a primary path to customers. Our mission is to make Liquid AI a preferred AI foundation across edge computing platforms through deep technical and commercial partnerships.

You'll work closely with senior leadership, product, engineering and go-to-market teams, initially leading selected partnerships end to end, with the opportunity to take broader ownership of Liquid's silicon ecosystem as the organization grows.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We need someone who:

 - Executes to the finish line: You move fast, act before every data point is in, and measure your work by outcomes (a signed agreement, a shipped product, a live customer), not by the introductions you made.

 - Brings structure with judgment: You have an entrepreneurial mindset and a high degree of ownership: you draw on what has worked before, adapt it to a fast-moving startup, and build process where none exists yet.

 - Learns the technology out of curiosity: You're passionate about edge AI and ask questions until you understand the technical substance, even when you're not the most technical person in the room.




THE WORK

 - Build and execute strategic silicon partnerships: own relationships with assigned partners, run co-design programs between their product groups and Liquid's teams, and negotiate agreements through to signature.

 - Define joint products: work with partners on what their hardware and Liquid's models and agents deliver together, and drive integration, optimization and benchmarking with both engineering teams.

 - Drive ecosystem adoption and distribution: take joint products to partner business groups, OEMs and system integrators, and identify the customers to pursue first.

 - Develop joint go-to-market: bring Liquid's go-to-market team into partner-sourced opportunities, and lead joint launches, demonstrations and events such as CES.

 - Lead cross-functional execution: turn partnership commitments into plans with clear milestones and owners, and resolve technical, commercial and organizational blockers.




EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES

What you'll need:

 - A proven track record of developing and executing strategic partnerships that drive measurable outcomes: signed agreements, shipped integrations, and customers

 - Experience working with silicon vendors, hardware platforms, OEMs, or embedded computing ecosystems

 - Experience leading commercial negotiations and structuring partnerships involving technical integration, distribution, or joint go-to-market

 - Product thinking: defining what a joint offering does, who buys it, and why

 - Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem and the evolving roles of AI models, inference software, and hardware platforms

 - Ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business organizations

Helpful, not required:

 - Experience with AI inference, machine learning infrastructure, or edge AI

 - Familiarity with CPU, GPU, and NPU architectures and their software ecosystems

 - Background in AI PCs, mobile devices, automotive, IoT, robotics, or embedded systems

 - Existing relationships with major semiconductor companies




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (YEAR ONE)

 - At least one silicon partnership taken from early discussions to a signed agreement, a defined joint product, and target customers both companies are pursuing, with Liquid's go-to-market team running the customer conversations and the program moving without your day-to-day involvement




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Partnerships with real pull: Leading silicon providers are already engaging; you own converting that demand into shipped products, with a path to leading Liquid's ecosystem strategy.

 - Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.

 - Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.

 - Paid Leave: Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Float Medical Receptionist (Bethesda)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Float Front Desk Associate (internally known as a Flex Member Support Specialist) you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect. Our Flex Member Support Specialists support multiple offices in a Market.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $21.50 per hour based on a full time schedule.

Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts taking place Monday-Friday between 6:30am-7:30pm. The role is based in our office in Bethesda, MD and will float to Chevy Chase, Silver Spring, and Pike & Rose offices for coverage as needed. Flex Member Support Specialists lend support to multiple One Medical locations and schedules are subject to change.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

WHO WE NEED

You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician - Murfreesboro, TN
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Analyst / Technician
jobs.description:

Professionals from environmental testing, forensic toxicology, pharmaceutical analysis, veterinary diagnostics, and related laboratory settings are encouraged to apply. Direct experience in animal toxicology is not required.

Key Responsibilities

 -  Prepare biological samples, including urine and blood specimens, for analytical testing.

 -  Perform liquid-liquid extraction, wet chemistry, and other sample preparation procedures.

 -  Conduct routine screening and confirmation testing using established analytical methods.

 -  Operate and maintain liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), including triple quadrupole systems.

 -  Work with Agilent instrumentation and associated analytical software.

 -  Prepare reagents, standards, calibration solutions, and quality control samples.

 -  Maintain accurate sample records, laboratory documentation, and test results.

 -  Follow quality assurance and quality control procedures consistent with ISO/IEC 17025 standards.

 -  Perform routine calibration, instrument maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.

 -  Support daily laboratory operations and learn new methods, equipment, and software as needed.

Required Qualifications

 -  Hands-on experience in an analytical laboratory environment.

 -  Experience with wet chemistry, sample preparation, or extraction techniques.

 -  Familiarity with laboratory equipment, analytical procedures, and quality control practices.

 -  Strong attention to detail, reproducibility, and accurate documentation.

 -  Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a small-team setting.

 -  Willingness to learn specialized testing methods and analytical instrumentation.

Preferred Qualifications

 -  Experience with liquid-liquid extraction of biological, environmental, or chemical samples.

 -  Experience with LC-MS/MS (triple quadrupole mass spectrometry) or comparable analytical instrumentation.

 -  Familiarity with Agilent instrumentation and analytical software.

 -  Background in environmental testing, forensic toxicology, pharmaceutical analysis, veterinary diagnostics, or analytical chemistry.

 -  Experience in an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited or other regulated laboratory.

 -  Associate or bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, forensic science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

 -  Apply and expand your analytical chemistry and instrumentation skills in a specialized laboratory.

 -  Work directly with modern LC-MS/MS technology and established quality procedures.

 -  Join a collaborative, hands-on laboratory team.

 -  Maintain a regular Monday–Friday, approximately 40-hour workweek.

 -  Employer-paid medical insurance premiums.

Compensation and Location

 - Annual compensation is approximately $80,000, depending on education, technical skills, and relevant experience. 

 - This is a fully onsite position in the Phoenix metropolitan area.

 - Schedule: Monday - Friday, approximately 40 hours per week.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Relief) - Franklin, TN
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous referral reward program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Care Navigator
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

Blackbird Health’s Care Navigators are an essential part of our integrated and collaborative care team. This isn't just an administrative role; once a new patient or family has begun care, you serve as a constant source of support and operate as the ultimate owner of their experience - answering questions, providing education, ushering on to next steps, and ensuring each patient is well cared for.

What makes you, you:

• People-Focused: You have a passion for providing high-quality, human-centered service, with a knack for building rapport and ensuring others feel supported and understood.

• A Natural Problem-Solver: You are proactive and resourceful, able to anticipate needs and solve complex issues with an eye towards improving processes and experiences for the future

• Detail-Oriented: You have a meticulous approach to administrative tasks from scheduling and documentation to tracking and managing communications, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

• Tech-Savvy: You are proficient with technology and can quickly learn new platforms like our EHR and scheduling tools. You’re comfortable navigating phone systems, text messaging, and email to provide transparent and timely communication.

• Collaborative & Independent: You thrive in a team environment- excited to pitch in and support your peers- and can also work independently - doing the right thing and operating with an ownership mindset.

How you’ll make an impact:

• Deliver a Seamless Patient Experience: Be the main point of contact for established patients, fielding inbound calls, messages, and emails with exceptional responsiveness, empathy, and professionalism. You’ll answer questions, track down information, and ensure families feel heard and supported with transparency and follow-up.

• Navigate the Care Journey: Guide patients and families through our care model, including scheduling and confirming appointments (both initial evaluations and ongoing therapy/medication checks). You'll manage a specific group of providers, becoming familiar with their practices to ensure patients are scheduled appropriately and receive timely access to care. You’ll also own the critical administrative tasks that make care possible such as managing provider orders, screenings, and scheduling.

• In-Office Support: As an in person teammate, you'll help maintain a welcoming and professional in-office environment - supporting patients and providers in person, managing mail, restocking supplies, opening/closing the office, and generally ensuring our physical spaces support a great experience.

• Uphold Privacy & Compliance: You will be a guardian of patient privacy, adhering to strict confidentiality and data protection standards, including HIPAA regulations and complex family consent laws, to ensure all sensitive information is handled securely and ethically.

This position is onsite, 5 days a week.

Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision coverage

• 401k (with a company match)

• Employer-paid life insurance coverage

• Generous paid time off

• Opportunities for career growth

• Diverse and experienced leadership team, supportive work culture

Salary Range

$23—$26 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.location: Chicago, IL 60607, United States; San Francisco, CA 94158, United States
jobs.description:
Schedule: Full Time

Job Type: Hybrid

Salary Type: Salary

Req #: 3654

About the Role

Uber Freight connects shippers with carriers, revolutionizing how goods move across the globe. Logistics is an intricate physical and digital ecosystem where minutes and timing equate to millions of dollars. We are looking for entrepreneurial Product Managers who thrive in ambiguity, love tackling multi-sided marketplace challenges, and possess the drive to build platforms that deliver measurable customer and business value at scale.

As a Product Manager at Uber Freight, you will own a critical domain across our ecosystem—spanning AI & algorithmic optimization, marketplace liquidity and integrity, financial systems, or shipper/carrier experiences. You will partner with engineers, data scientists, designers, operations teams, and commercial stakeholders to translate complex logistics problems into scalable products and step-change business outcomes.

What You'll Do

• Define Product Vision & Strategy: Own the end-to-end vision, strategy, and roadmap for a core product area. Translate complex logistics realities and market shifts into actionable hypotheses, clear milestones, and prioritized execution.

• Customer Obsessed: Empathize deeply with our dual-sided ecosystem—carriers, drivers, enterprise shippers, and internal operators. Run through walls to eliminate user friction, obsessing over defect data and building solutions that earn long-term trust.

• Be in the Arena: Tackle the hardest, most ambiguous problems in transportation and supply chain. Step up to make high-conviction decisions with incomplete data, take calculated risks, and embrace accountability for the outcomes.

• Win as One: Build bridges across cross-functional partners in engineering, data science, operations, marketing, sales, and legal. Seek input broadly, align divergent goals, resolve dependencies, and ensure the entire team moves in unison to deliver shared wins.

• Move with Urgency: Operate with a default-to-action mindset. Accelerate discovery, prototyping, and validation by integrating modern AI tooling into daily workflows, balancing rapid iteration with thoughtful architecture.

• We Raise the Bar: Hold yourself and the team to the highest standard of execution. Uplevel team effectiveness, mentor and elevate peer PMs, and drive step-change improvements across key marketplace, financial, and efficiency metrics.

• Communicate with Radical Clarity: Present roadmaps, tradeoffs, investment decisions, and analytical findings with precision and transparency to audiences ranging from frontline dispatchers to executive leaders.

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of Product Management experience building, scaling, and managing software products throughout the full product lifecycle.

• Data-First Problem Solving: Proven ability to query, structure, and analyze large-scale datasets independently (proficient in SQL) to uncover insights, audit defects, and validate hypotheses.

• Cross-Functional Execution: Demonstrated track record leading multi-disciplinary teams (engineering, UX/design, data science, and business/operations) through roadmap delivery and system launches.

• Strategic & Analytical Rigor: Experience taking complex business, financial, or operational constraints and synthesizing them into a cohesive product strategy with quantified ROI.

• Executive Presence: Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort presenting strategies, justifying tradeoffs, and pushing back constructively on leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building within two-sided marketplaces, freight/logistics networks, enterprise SaaS, or B2B fintech/financial systems.

• Experience collaborating with Data Science on machine learning, predictive modeling, reinforcement learning, or operational research platforms.

• Hands-on application of modern AI technologies (e.g., LLMs, reasoning models, prompt/context engineering, or agent orchestration) to redesign workflows or build customer-facing intelligence.

• Expertise in marketplace experimentation design (e.g., switchback testing, synthetic controls, cluster-based randomization) to measure network effects.

• Comfort operating at the intersection of high-growth technology and boots-on-the-ground physical operations.

Benefits & Compensation for U.S. Employees

Employees working more than 30 hours in the US at Uber Freight are eligible for benefits like a company sponsored health plan, dental and vision benefits, 401k match, financial and mental wellness benefits, parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage, life insurance and more.  US based employees may also be eligible for a performance or sales incentive bonus program, participation in Uber Freight equity awards, and other types of compensation depending upon the role.

About Uber Freight

Uber Freight helps companies move goods more reliably and efficiently. We bring together the technology, people, and transportation capacity they need, using real‑time data from millions of shipments to guide smarter decisions. That helps customers spot issues early, avoid costly surprises, and deliver on time. Uber Freight works with 1 in 3 Fortune 500 shippers across North America and manages over $17B in freight. Learn more at www.uberfreight.com.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Uber Freight is committed to protecting the privacy of our candidates. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. For detailed information on how we handle candidate data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

EEOC

Uber Freight is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Lead Technician, Electrical Assembly Testing
jobs.description:

Commonwealth Fusion Systems is on a mission to deliver the urgent transition to fusion energy.
 
Combining decades of research, top talent, and new technologies, we’re designing and building commercially viable fusion power plants. And we're working with policymakers, suppliers, and many others to build the energy industry of the future.
 
We’re in the best position to make it happen. Since 2018, we’ve raised $4 billion of capital, making us the largest and leading fusion company in the world.
 
Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team. 
 
If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you.


Join the power movement as a Lead Technician, Electrical Assembly Testing 
 
The Lead Technician is a critical operational leadership role responsible for overseeing the execution, safety, and scheduling of testing across three distinct domains: Electrical, Instrumentation & Controls (I&C), and Fiber Optics.
 
This role manages a blended team of internal technicians and specialized vendor partners, ensuring that daily testing, troubleshooting, and assembly milestones are hitsafely and efficiently. executing work in the manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Recruiter, GTM - AMER (Fixed Term Contract)
jobs.description:
Chainalysis is the leader in blockchain intelligence, defining how trust is built in the digital economy. We're operating at the cutting edge of one of the world's fastest-growing industries, shaping what comes next. Over the last 2 years, Chainalysis has made big bets and moved fast to capture the market opportunity in front of us: we've accelerated growth, landed enterprise-wide contracts at the world's largest financial institutions, completed four acquisitions to build our AI talent and expand our products, and launched our first agentic product to select customers.



The Talent Acquisition team at Chainalysis is responsible for scaling the most important ingredient to our success: people. Our job is to build and execute a talent acquisition strategy that is inclusive, rigorous, and repeatable around the world. As we enter a period of significant go-to-market growth, we're investing heavily in our sales organization and need a recruiter who can match that pace.



We're looking for a Recruiter, Go-to-Market who will own and drive hiring for sales and go-to-market roles at Chainalysis. This is a high-volume, outbound-heavy role. You'll spend a meaningful portion of your time building pipeline through direct sourcing, identifying and engaging top sales talent across crypto, fintech, and traditional financial services. You'll manage a full requisition load, move fast, and close strong candidates in a competitive market, with Account Executive roles among your key hires. You'll work closely with hiring managers across our enterprise and public sector sales teams, acting as a recruiting partner who understands the business and delivers results.



Please note that this position is a 6 month Fixed Term Contract initially






IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:




BUILD PIPELINE THROUGH OUTBOUND SOURCING

 - Own pipeline generation for go-to-market roles, with a heavy emphasis on proactive outbound sourcing to find and engage top sales talent

 - Map the competitive landscape across crypto, fintech, and traditional financial services to identify where strong Account Executives and quota-carrying sellers work today

 - Develop creative sourcing strategies that go beyond LinkedIn InMails, including referral generation, community engagement, and direct outreach campaigns

 - Maintain a high volume of outbound activity to keep pipeline ahead of hiring demand




RUN FULL-CYCLE RECRUITING AT PACE

 - Own the full recruiting lifecycle for go-to-market roles, from intake and sourcing through offer negotiation and close

 - Manage a high-volume requisition load across enterprise and public sector go-to-market teams

 - Move candidates through the process efficiently while delivering a thoughtful, personalized, and transparent candidate experience at every step

 - Make data-driven decisions about pipeline health, conversion rates, and sourcing channel effectiveness to keep hiring on track




PARTNER WITH HIRING MANAGERS AND THE BUSINESS

 - Build trusted relationships with sales leaders to develop a deep understanding of their teams, priorities, and what great looks like for each hire

 - Guide hiring managers through the recruiting process with clear communication, calibrated expectations, and market insights

 - Share competitive intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and hiring trends across relevant markets

 - Provide regular pipeline updates and flag risks early so hiring plans stay on schedule




CONTRIBUTE TO TALENT ACQUISITION AS A TEAM

 - Champion diversity and inclusion in every search, with intentional focus on engaging candidates from underrepresented backgrounds

 - Share sourcing wins, market learnings, and process improvements across the Talent Acquisition team

 - Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, tools, and candidate experiences

 - Occasionally provide recruiting support for roles outside of go-to-market as priorities and bandwidth allow




WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong track record of hiring sales and go-to-market talent, specifically quota-carrying roles such as Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Business Development Representatives

 - Demonstrated outbound sourcing ability: you build your own pipeline, generate candidate interest through direct outreach, and do not rely on inbound applications to fill roles

 - Proven track record of recruiting sales talent within the SaaS and Cybersecurity sectors, with a specific focus on candidates who have successfully sold complex solutions into the Fintech, Cryptocurrency, or Traditional Financial Services markets.

 - Comfort operating at high volume and managing multiple open requisitions simultaneously without dropping quality or candidate experience

 - Strong organizational skills with sharp attention to detail and consistent follow-through on every candidate and requisition

 - The ability to build credibility with hiring managers quickly, communicate market realities clearly, and guide decisions with data

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach to working on a small, close-knit Talent Acquisition team

 - Curiosity about our industry and genuine interest in learning the Chainalysis product suite and competitive landscape




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience recruiting for public sector go-to-market roles (Federal, DoD/Intel)

 - Familiarity with government clearance requirements and their impact on candidate pools

 - Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO technology company

 - Experience working with Ashby ATS and sourcing tools

 - Recruiting experience beyond core sales roles, such as professional services, solutions engineering, or customer success



This role is ineligible for visa sponsorship.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.
