jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Manager (Corporate Finance)
jobs.description:
About the Team

Netlify's Finance team builds the financial foundation that helps the company plan, operate, and make informed decisions. The team owns our operating model, management reporting, budgeting and planning, and the company-level metrics leadership uses to understand performance and make tradeoffs.

As Senior Finance Manager, you'll own the corporate finance cycle and decide what it should become. That covers monthly reporting, the driver-based forecast, annual planning, scenario work, and the KPI layer, and it extends past running them well into bringing your experience to improve and innovate on our processes. This is a hands-on role with real latitude: you will work directly with senior leadership on capital, pricing, and headcount decisions, and will leverage AI to build better tooling and make Finance faster and less dependent on manual work.

What You'll Do

• Own the corporate finance cycle end to end, including the monthly reporting package, the driver-based forecast, annual planning, and scenario analysis, and redesign the parts that no longer hold up as we scale

• Frame which scenarios are worth running ahead of capital, pricing, and headcount decisions, and bring a recommendation rather than a set of outputs

• Lead the annual planning process across departments, from calendar and templates through consolidation and board-ready output

• Lead cross-functional alignment on metric definitions, reporting dimensions and financial data hygiene

• Own the company-level KPI and metrics layer, decide what leadership measures as the business evolves, and carry a view on the trends driving each metric

• Drive market and competitor research to support pricing and packaging, capital allocation, and improve financial forecasting

• Communicate complex financial mechanics to people outside finance, and drive cross-functional decisions and leadership buy-in

• Set how budget management runs across departments, including the cadence and what a department leader is accountable for, rather than tracking it on their behalf

• Be a thought leader steering the finance function's AI operating standard and build the systems and agents to support it

• Partner with Sales leadership on capacity model and KPI tracking

What You'll Bring

• 7+ years in FP&A or strategic finance, including several years at a SaaS or usage-based business. An investment banking, consulting or private equity background preferred; but strong modeling skills, ability to develop frameworks to solve complex problems and ability to run scenarios is a must

• Multiple annual planning cycles owned end to end

• A history of building 3-statement models from scratch, with scenario and sensitivity analysis, and of making structural changes to a model rather than only updating inputs

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and core accounting principles

• Advanced Google Sheets or Excel, and comfort with large datasets and formula-heavy models

• Comfort framing abstract business problems and creating frameworks to address them

• Deep system-level understanding of how financial data moves across source systems, the warehouse, and the planning and reporting layer

• Deep command of SaaS metrics and their drivers, with a point of view on which ones actually matter at our stage

• Working knowledge of SQL

• Hands-on experience building AI workflows other teams adopt, and a clear view on where the human checks belongs

• Experience presenting analysis and recommendations to executive staff, and a track record of driving org level impact

• Deep curiosity about our business, product, customers, competitors and industry trends

This Role Is a Great Fit If

• You want to own a function, not contribute to one. The corporate finance cycle would be yours to run and to redesign.

• You're comfortable being the only person on this work. There is no junior analyst supporting the role and no plan to add one. You will build it and run it yourself.

• You’re deeply curious about industry. You keep up to date with industry trends, research the competitive landscape, and you turn that into a recommendation rather than an observation.

• You notice when something is slower or more manual than it needs to be, and you fix it without being asked.

• You're excited to build. The tooling, the reporting layer, and the automation work are all genuinely open, and there is room to make this function structurally better.

Our applications will close on Friday, November 13th at 5pm CST

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include:

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to "build a better web" and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you'd like to be part of, we're excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify's equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $150,000 - $208,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MIND:

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.


THE ROLE:

At Mind Robotics, we're building generalized physical AI — robotic systems capable of dexterous, adaptive, reasoning-intensive and most importantly safe work in real-world industrial environments. Systems engineering is the discipline that holds it all together: translating mission requirements into hardware reality and ensuring every subsystem behaves as a coherent whole.


We're looking for a Systems Engineer to own the requirements and architecture baseline for the robot — from decomposing high-level behaviors into measurable, traceable specs, to making sure the system and its safety requirements hold together from concept through field deployment. You'll define how the robot is supposed to behave, how we prove it, and what "ready to ship" means, working alongside software, mechanical, electrical, and integration teams.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the system requirements baseline: capture top-level robot behaviors and performance targets, and decompose them into measurable subsystem requirements, budgets, and interfaces, with traceability through to verification

 - Define software requirements from high-level system requirements, using first-principles analysis and hardware/model-based testing

 - Contribute to architectural decisions for new robot subsystems — communication protocols, control strategies, and hardware-software partitioning — alongside firmware/controls, mechanical, and electrical teams

 - Own interface definitions across mechanical, electrical, firmware, controls, and software, and manage requirement and interface changes and their cross-subsystem impact

 - Lead system-level failure mode and hazard analysis (DFMEA, HARA, FTA) together with subsystem owners, and derive, allocate, and trace the resulting safety requirements to subsystems and their verification

 - Work cross-functionally to drive the verification and validation strategy: system-level test plans from bench testing through field deployment, acceptance criteria, and requirements coverage

 - Work cross-functionally with subsystem owners to drive requirements and system-level coverage for on-robot diagnostics, telemetry, and health monitoring that support field deployment and service

 - Drive readiness reviews, sign-off, and post-launch monitoring across firmware, hardware, controls, reliability, and manufacturing stakeholders

 - Work with integration engineers to turn bench and field findings into requirement, interface, and design changes


REQUIREMENTS:

 - Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent experience

 - 5+ years in systems engineering on complex electromechanical, robotic, or autonomous products, including at least one product taken through to field deployment

 - Demonstrated experience writing, decomposing, and managing requirements — making high-level system behaviors measurable and testable, with traceability from requirement to design to verification

 - Hands-on experience with hazard and risk analysis (DFMEA/FMEDA, HARA, FTA) and turning the results into requirements and test cases

 - Working knowledge of functional safety standards and concepts (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, IEC 62061, ISO 26262, or similar)

 - Strong hardware and software fundamentals — able to bridge electrical schematics, embedded communication protocols, and firmware architecture, and to debug system-level issues alongside integration and firmware engineers

 - Proficient in data analysis and scripting — able to use hardware and field data to validate or challenge requirements

 - Clear written and verbal communication — specs that mechanical, electrical, and firmware teams can all build and test against

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and have an "engineering curiosity" that drives you to understand how the entire system works, not just your part


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, Polarion, DOORS, etc.) or model-based systems engineering (SysML)

 - Experience supporting product safety certification (NRTL or notified body) as a technical contributor

 - Experience specifying or validating systems that include learned/ML-based components

 - Background in robotics, EV powertrains, drones, aerospace, or other dense electromechanical systems

 - Exposure to manufacturing self-test design or service diagnostics

jobs.title: Director, Buyer Account Management
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

B-Stock is searching for an experienced B2B Buyer Development Director with a track record of over-performance and demonstrated success leading and developing sales talent. This person will own a portfolio of high-value buyer accounts while directly managing a team of Buyer Account Managers and driving both individual and team performance in large-scale liquidation inventory sales.

As a member of the Buyer Account Management Team, the Director, Buyer Account Management will accelerate GMV growth by bringing in new high-value buyers, expanding strategic buyer relationships, and coaching team members to qualify, onboard, retain, and scale large B2B liquidation buyers. The Director is accountable for clear team goals, consistent execution, buyer experience, performance management, and employee development. The ideal candidate combines advanced B2B sales expertise and buyer relationships with a hands-on, supportive management approach that builds accountability and a strong leadership bench.

This person applies AI throughout their own and their team’s sales motions, from prospecting and buyer research to pipeline management, and develops repeatable, increasingly automated workflows that improve team productivity and precision. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Buyer Account Management, this individual contributes to long-term buyer growth, team capability, and revenue targets.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• IDENTIFY

• Generate new big buyer leads through cold outreach, trade shows, inbound marketing follow-up, and other buyer marketing initiatives.

• Build AI-enabled prospecting and account-research workflows to find, qualify, and prioritize high-value buyers at scale.

• Leverage a professional network to connect with key decision-makers; coach the team on prospecting and account targeting.

• Prospect into target seller accounts for more inventory.

• Maintain accurate Salesforce activity and pipeline records; establish consistent reporting and pipeline hygiene expectations for direct reports.

• ENGAGE

• Create, position, and sell the full value of B-Stock solutions to high-value buyers.

• Deliver concise, effective sales pitches tailored to each prospect; coach direct reports in discovery, negotiation, and relationship management.

• Partner closely with Account Management, Client Operations, Customer Service, Logistics, and other teams to execute transactions and resolve buyer obstacles.

• Step into complex escalations and help team members create practical solutions across programs, inventory, shipping, and operational constraints.

• CLOSE

• Achieve quarterly individual and team GMV and sales objectives by maintaining healthy pipelines and consistent execution.

• Build and grow a book of large buyers purchasing more than $500,000 annually, while helping direct reports increase buyer spend, retention, and account value.

• Increase transaction volume, buyer purchase frequency, and value delivered on the B-Stock platform.

• Use AI-driven automation within Salesforce and buyer data sources to surface expansion signals, improve forecasting, and tailor recommendations to buyer buying patterns; scale effective practices across the team.

• LEAD, COACH & DEVELOP PEOPLE

• Directly manage assigned Buyer Account Managers, setting clear responsibilities, measurable performance expectations, and priorities aligned with GMV, retention, buyer growth, and company goals.

• Hold consistent 1:1 meetings, team meetings, pipeline reviews, and performance check-ins; provide timely, specific coaching, constructive feedback, recognition, and support to remove obstacles.

• Evaluate performance fairly using results, behaviors, and role-specific competency tracks; identify performance gaps early, document expectations, and drive improvement plans in partnership with People leadership as appropriate.

• Partner with each direct report to create and maintain an Individual Development Plan and actionable Grow development areas, informed by personal strengths, career aspirations, competency expectations, and business needs. Review and update growth milestones and goals at least monthly.

• Identify stretch assignments, cross-functional projects, mentoring, peer learning, and training opportunities to build account management, negotiation, analytical, operational, and leadership capabilities.

• Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, reinforce strong operating practices and CRM discipline, and share effective sales plays and AI workflows across the team.

• Foster an inclusive, trusting, high-accountability team environment where employees feel comfortable raising issues, collaborating, giving feedback, and taking ownership of results and career development.

• Recognize high potential talent and build succession readiness by preparing strong team members for larger accounts, expanded responsibilities, and future leadership opportunities.

• Translate leadership priorities into clear team plans and capacity decisions, communicate progress and risks, and take accountability for both team wins and gaps.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

• 8+ years of experience in quota-carrying, enterprise B2B transactions with a proven history of exceeding goals.

• Experience in marketplace business models, buyer account management, and re-commerce sales.

• Ability to develop and execute strategic and tactical account plans and translate business objectives into clear team goals.

• Professional network of C-level or VP-level buyer contacts.

• Hands-on experience building AI automations or agentic processes for prospect research, outreach, pipeline analysis, and sales productivity, and ability to coach adoption across a team.

• Strong judgment, creativity, conflict resolution, and ability to manage difficult conversations and complex cross-functional problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, coaching, prioritization, and collaboration skills.

• Proficiency with MS Office, Salesforce.com, and other CRM tools.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, entrepreneurship, or related field.

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with structured development practices, competency rubrics, Individual Development Plans, and career growth tools.

• Knowledge of eCommerce, supply chain, ERP, or logistics software solutions.

• Experience in SaaS selling and a start-up-like environment.

• Experience building custom assistants, projects, or agents on AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok to support buyer workflows and team coaching.

• Demonstrated people leadership experience, including direct-report management, coaching, performance evaluation, and employee development.

• Experience leading a sales or account management team to measurable growth and performance outcomes.

The pay rate for this role will range between $150,000 to $180,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

• Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)

• Support for continuing education

• Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple

• Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/

OUR VALUES

Make Each Dollar Count
Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us.

Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves
Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves).

Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow
We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals.

Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success
The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed.

Find Strength In Numbers
Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers.

No applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” B-Stock also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at B-Stock.

jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

Blackbird Health is looking to hire a Market Liaison to join our growing team. This role will serve as the primary external-facing ambassador for Blackbird Health across designated Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania territories, building high-trust relationships with pediatricians, primary care groups, school districts, universities, and community stakeholders. The Market Liaison will drive referral partner activation, establish seamless referral pathways, and collaborate internally to ensure patients and partners receive an exceptional care experience.

What Makes You, You

• Relationship Builder: Highly engaging, empathetic, and energized by establishing rapport with clinical, school, and community partners.

• Strategic Territory Owner: Proactive in analyzing account activity, identifying growth opportunities, and prioritizing outreach efforts.

• Clear Communicator: Articulate spokesperson capable of explaining complex care models and clinical access pathways concisely.

• Data-Informed Operator: Organized and disciplined in leveraging Customer Relationship Management tools to track activity, monitor activation rates, and optimize strategy.

• Mission-Driven Advocate: Passionate about expanding access to high-quality pediatric mental health care for children and families.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Establish, cultivate, and expand strategic relationships with pediatricians, primary care physicians, therapists, school districts, universities, and community partners across Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

• Manage territory outreach rhythms, balancing cold stops, warm introductions, educational lunches, and ongoing partner engagement.

• Partner with external practices to implement clear referral channels, explain turnaround expectations, and streamline collaborative care processes.

• Analyze account performance using Customer Relationship Management tools, proactively identifying underperforming or churned accounts and developing re-engagement strategies.

• Collaborate internally with Care Navigation, Clinical Leadership, Marketing, and Operations to maintain feedback loops and smooth onboarding for new partners.

• Represent Blackbird Health at community events, conferences, school meetings, and provider gatherings to build brand awareness.

The Basics You'll Need

• Demonstrated track record in healthcare outreach, physician relations, educational advocacy, medical sales, or territory management.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust quickly and communicate effectively with clinical and administrative audiences.

• Experience navigating local Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania healthcare systems, pediatric practices, or school district structures.

• Proficiency with Customer Relationship Management platforms (such as HubSpot or Salesforce) for pipeline and relationship tracking.

• Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and the ability to spend up to 75% of work time traveling across the assigned Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania region.

Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match

• Employer-paid life insurance coverage

• Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and parental leave

• Mileage reimbursement and cell phone stipend

• Opportunities for career growth and professional advancement within a rapidly growing organization

• Diverse and experienced leadership team, supportive work culture

Salary & Compensation

• Bonus: Up to 40% annual bonus based on goal achievement and market performance.

Join Us!

We envision a world where every young person is fully understood and receives support building the tools they need to thrive. Join our team, make an impact, a real difference for patients, parents and caregivers.

jobs.title: Validation and Verification Engineer, Aviation Engineering
jobs.description:
We're on a mission to make the skies safe and accessible for everyone. Our technology gives pilots greater control by simplifying the management of any aircraft during standard flight operations, inclement weather, and emergencies. Our SkyOS solution, rigorously and relentlessly developed by skilled and dedicated Skyrysers, is the key to unlocking this unbounded future. Our technology, combined with our commitment to saving lives and our passion for aviation, will empower everyone to experience the joy and freedom of flight.

VALIDATION & VERIFICATION ENGINEER, AVIATION ENGINEERING - EL SEGUNDO, CA

In this role, you will be responsible for the verification, validation, and quality assurance of Fly-by-Wire software, Display software, and FPGA firmware. You will create, execute, review tests at the high-level and low-level requirement levels, including FPGA requirements-based verification through simulation and hardware testing. You will also review requirements, design, code, and HDL using checklists. The ideal candidate will be familiar with ARP 4754A, DO-178C, DO-331, and DO-254, and capable of facilitating all FAA/DER reviews (SO1-1 to SO1-4 for software, and the equivalent DO-254 stages of involvement for airborne electronic hardware).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and conduct flight-critical tests and reviews of the Flight Control System software per DO-178C and DO-331

• Plan and execute Display software V&V per DO-178C, including requirements-based testing of display formats, symbology, pilot interactions, alerting, and data interfaces, and develop automated display test frameworks and test executives

• Plan and execute FPGA firmware verification per DO-254, including requirements-based HDL simulation, test bench development, code coverage analysis, elemental analysis, and in-target hardware testing

• Develop embedded systems test benches and perform processor-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing across multiple software, display, and FPGA components

• Develop verification testing tools and automation, qualify the test stand, and develop qualification procedures for the same

• Develop and maintain software and hardware certification plans and artifacts (e.g., SVP, HVP, verification tests and procedures, verification results, and compliance reports)

• Perform structural coverage analysis for software (LDRA or equivalent) and HDL code coverage for FPGA designs

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline

• 3+ years of experience in software, firmware, or hardware engineering in the certification of software and systems

• Experience developing software or hardware test and verification documents

• Experience with dSPACE or similar HIL tools

• Experience in Python, C, C++, and MATLAB

• Working knowledge of CAN, RTD, serial communication, ARINC 429, and UART

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering

• Experience designing, developing, verifying, and certifying display software per DO-178C

• Experience verifying and certifying FPGA designs per DO-254 (DAL A/B preferred), including proficiency in VHDL and/or Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, or cocotb test benches, and HDL simulation and synthesis tools such as Questa/ModelSim, Vivado, or Libero

• Experience with lab equipment for in-hardware verification (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers)

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision and influence the organization

WHY SKYRYSE?

• Heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans

• Full-time employees are eligible for 20 days of paid time off (PTO) and 5 sick days annually. PTO and sick days must be used in accordance with Company policy

The posted salary range reflects the potential base pay for this role, adjusted to account for varying geographic markets. Final compensation will be based on factors such as your location, job-related skills, experience, and internal alignment, including equity and benefits.

WE WELCOME ALL

jobs.title: Product Manager, HRI (Human Robot Interaction)
jobs.description:
Join Us in Building the Future of Home Robotics

At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 18 months building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.



Memo is the first home robot most of our users will ever live with. Everything he does — how he moves, what he says, how he sounds, what his lights mean, what the app tells you — makes an impression and builds or erodes trust. Human-robot interaction (HRI) is how we design all of that on purpose. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to HRI. You'll own Memo as a character and as an interface: his personality, voice, movement vocabulary, animations, lighting, sounds, and the user-facing communication across robot and app. You'll work with animators, sound and voice designers, app design, the behavior-stack engineers, and the consumer product team to make Memo legible, likable, and unmistakably himself. This is a role with product ownership — you decide what Memo should do and why, and work with designers, engineers, and animators to bring those actions on embodiment.

What You'll Do

 - Own Memo's character. Turn the existing bio into a living character bible — personality, point of view, voice, what he likes, how he behaves under stress — that every team designs against.

 - Own the HRI roadmap across every product surface: robot motion and gestures, audio and voice, lighting, and app state and notifications. Decide what Memo communicates, when, and through which channel.

 - Define and maintain the HRI trigger set: for each robot state and event, specify the user-facing response across robot and app so engineering can build to it and QA can regression-test it.

 - Lead animation as a product area. Set briefs for animators, run reviews, and own the three objectives: legibility (a fresh-eyed user can predict what Memo's about to do), marketable moments (filmable, on-demand behaviors), and delight.

 - Own Memo's voice and sound: the voice itself, how it syncs with motion, conversational tone and register, and how voice interactions and playback feel in a real home.

 - Design how Memo interacts with people, kids, and pets — greetings, waiting, asking for help, finishing a task, being interrupted — in partnership with the Trust & Safety PM on stop conditions and recovery.

 - Learn from real homes. Watch beta families live with Memo, pull HRI feedback from dogfooding and betas, and turn it into requirements.

 - Partner with the behavior-stack and animation-pipeline engineers on what the system can express, and push for the tooling product needs to review and test animations.

 - Define and track HRI metrics: intent legibility in user testing, unprompted positive mentions from beta families, voice and animation satisfaction, and response coverage across triggers.

What You'll Bring

 - 4+ years in product, interaction design, or character/experience design on products people talk to, live with, or play with — consumer robots, voice assistants, games, animated characters, toys, smart home, wearables, or similar.

 - Nice to have a design background and portfolio. You've shaped how something looks, moves, sounds, or talks, and can show it. You don't need to be the animator or the sound designer, but you need to direct them well.

 - Fluency in character and personality design: how a point of view, movement style, and voice combine into something people recognize and care about.

 - Experience working across animation, sound, and UI on one coherent experience, and holding the line on consistency across surfaces.

 - Enough technical grounding to work with engineers on what a robot can physically and computationally express, and to make tradeoffs between ideal and feasible.

 - Strong user research instincts. You watch people, notice what they misread, and fix it.

 - Comfort with ambiguity at an early-stage company. You can write the first version of a character bible that doesn't exist yet.

 - Bonus: robotics or physical product HRI experience; game or film character animation direction; voice/conversational design; work with TTS and motion-audio sync.

What success looks like in 6 months

 - A character bible for Memo exists and is used by animation, voice, app design, and engineering.

 - The HRI trigger set is complete for the core user journey across robot and app, with owners and regression tests.

 - Memo's voice, animations, and lighting read as one coherent character, and beta families say so unprompted.

 - A fresh-eyed user can tell what Memo is about to do, is doing, and whether it worked.

 - Animation and voice have clear briefs, a review process, and a roadmap.



At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

This role focuses heavily on USACE permitting, Clean Water Act compliance, NEPA documentation, and EPA regulations, with a strong emphasis on project management. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, managing complex environmental projects from planning through execution and regulatory approval.

• Manage multiple environmental projects simultaneously, including scope development, scheduling, budgeting, client communication, and quality control.

• Develop and manage National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) documentation, including Environmental Assessments (EAs), Environmental Impact Statements (EIS), and Categorical Exclusions (CatEx)

• Support business development efforts by assisting with proposals, cost estimates, and client presentations related to wetlands and regulatory services

• Experience with Louisiana state agency permitting including the Joint Permit Application process for work within Louisiana’s Coastal Zone

• Demonstrated expertise in: Wetlands delineation and permitting under the Clean Water Act USACE permit preparation and acquisition (Section 404/10) NEPA compliance and documentation EPA regulations and state-level environmental programs

• Ability to prepare and develop coordination efforts pursuant to Section 106 of the NHPA, DOT Section 4(f), Section 7 and Section 10 of the Endangered Species Act

jobs.title: Program Manager, Maintenance
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

As we scale production across multiple sites, maintenance isn't an afterthought; it's the backbone that keeps high-throughput, automation-heavy factories running. We're standing up a central maintenance function from a blank sheet of paper, and we need a leader to own it end to end.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Maintenance Program Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and sustaining standardized industrial maintenance practices across manufacturing operations. This role serves as a strategic and operational partner to site leadership, providing guidance, oversight, and technical expertise to establish scalable, reliable, and high-performing maintenance organizations. Working closely with local maintenance management, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, and business leadership, the Maintenance Program Manager will drive maintenance governance, organizational capability development, performance management, and continuous improvement. The position plays a critical role in institutionalizing maintenance standards, improving equipment reliability, developing workforce capabilities, and ensuring consistent execution of maintenance strategies across an expanding manufacturing footprint.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Maintenance Governance & Standardization

• Develop, deploy, and maintain standardized industrial maintenance policies, procedures, and operating practices across manufacturing locations.

• Establish minimum requirements for preventive maintenance, predictive maintenance, corrective maintenance, documentation, and equipment reliability.

• Guide local management teams in establishing foundational maintenance practices and organizational disciplines.

• Develop and maintain maintenance governance frameworks, including defined roles, responsibilities, accountability, and escalation protocols.

• Support consistent implementation of maintenance standards while accommodating program-specific operational requirements.

Maintenance Auditing & Performance Management

• Conduct periodic assessments of local maintenance organizations to evaluate operational maturity, procedural compliance, and organizational effectiveness.

• Establish standardized maintenance audit criteria, assessment scorecards, and corrective action tracking.

• Evaluate compliance with established maintenance KPIs, including equipment availability, MTTR, MTBF, PM compliance, schedule adherence, and maintenance backlog.

• Audit maintenance documentation, equipment records, PM procedures, spare parts practices, and work-order management.

• Identify organizational and operational gaps, develop corrective action plans, and monitor progress toward closure.

• Establish consistent reporting practices and performance reviews across manufacturing programs.

Organizational Development & Scalability

• Partner with local leadership to assess maintenance staffing requirements based on equipment complexity, asset criticality, production demands, and operational maturity.

• Support the development of scalable maintenance organizational structures aligned with business growth.

• Establish standardized maintenance roles, responsibilities, and technical competency expectations.

• Assist local management teams with workforce planning, organizational readiness, and resource allocation.

• Develop maintenance organizational maturity models and deployment roadmaps for new and expanding manufacturing operations.

• Support maintenance readiness assessments during new equipment installations, production ramp-ups, and facility expansions.

Training, Competency Development & Career Pathing

• Develop standardized technical training frameworks and competency matrices for maintenance personnel.

• Establish skill requirements and proficiency expectations across maintenance technician, specialist, and leadership positions.

• Partner with local management and training organizations to identify technical capability gaps and establish development plans.

• Develop structured career progression pathways, including technician advancement, specialization, and leadership development.

• Support technical onboarding, qualification, and certification programs.

• Establish mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness and verify demonstrated technical competency.

• Promote knowledge sharing and technical best practices across manufacturing locations.

Maintenance Systems & Process Development

• Support the implementation and standardization of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

• Establish requirements for asset hierarchies, equipment master data, maintenance plans, work-order documentation, and maintenance history.

• Develop standardized processes for spare parts management, inventory controls, equipment criticality, and single-point-of-failure assessments.

• Support the development of preventive and predictive maintenance programs based on equipment risk and operational requirements.

• Establish maintenance documentation standards, including OEM manuals, technical procedures, equipment records, and maintenance instructions.

• Partner with site teams to improve planning, scheduling, and maintenance execution.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Identify systemic maintenance performance gaps and coordinate improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.

• Promote reliability-centered maintenance principles and data-driven maintenance decision-making.

• Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving and root cause analysis for recurring equipment failures.

• Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, and other operational excellence methodologies.

• Establish mechanisms for sharing lessons learned, proven practices, and technical improvements across sites.

• Track improvement initiatives and quantify their impact on equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and maintenance effectiveness.

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Execution

• Serve as a central point of coordination between corporate maintenance leadership and local manufacturing organizations.

• Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, EHS, Procurement, and business leaders to align maintenance capabilities with operational requirements.

• Support the definition and deployment of maintenance service-level agreements (SLAs), performance expectations, and accountability structures.

• Maintain program-level implementation plans, milestones, ownership assignments, and progress reporting.

• Communicate organizational risks, capability gaps, and improvement opportunities to maintenance leadership.

• Drive execution through influence, collaboration, and structured follow-up across geographically distributed teams.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant experience considered.

• 7+ years of experience in industrial maintenance, manufacturing engineering, equipment reliability, or maintenance operations.

• Demonstrated experience developing or improving maintenance processes within complex manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of preventive maintenance, predictive maintenance, reliability engineering, and maintenance performance metrics.

• Experience with CMMS platforms, maintenance documentation, and work-order management.

• Experience assessing maintenance organizational effectiveness and identifying operational improvement opportunities.

• Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

• Ability to influence local management teams and drive standardization without direct reporting authority.

• Ability to travel to manufacturing locations as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations or diverse manufacturing programs.

• Previous experience as a Maintenance Manager, Reliability Manager, Maintenance Excellence Leader, or Maintenance Program Manager.

• Experience establishing maintenance organizations within greenfield facilities or rapidly scaling manufacturing environments.

• Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, Six Sigma, and reliability-centered maintenance.

• Experience developing technical training programs, competency matrices, and career progression frameworks.

• Experience implementing CMMS systems and standardizing maintenance data across multiple facilities.

• Familiarity with automated manufacturing equipment, robotics, industrial controls, and complex electromechanical systems.

• Experience developing maintenance governance, audit programs, and organizational maturity assessments.

US Salary Range

$114,000—$152,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Join Us in Building the Future of Home Robotics

At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 18 months building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.



What to Expect

Sunday is putting robots into homes — around kids, pets, furniture, and families who haven't lived with a robot before. No regulatory body has defined what "safe" means for a home robot yet. We're defining it ourselves, and our brand depends on getting it right. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to trust and safety. You'll own the safety and privacy requirements for Memo end to end: what we test, what we promise users, and what we refuse to ship. You'll work across robot software, hardware, controls, ML, app, design, and operations to make safety a property of the whole system, not one team's checklist.

What You'll Do

 - Own the safety and trust roadmap for Memo. Define what "safe enough to ship" means for each release, and hold the line on it.

 - Build the system-level safety case. Map failure modes across navigation, hardware, controls, task design, firmware, and user communications, and make sure each has an owner, a test, and a mitigation.

 - Work with engineering to define and track safety test coverage for every subsystem. Ensure firmware and software releases are validated against safety requirements before OTA.

 - Own data privacy for the product: what Memo records in the home, who can see it (including teleoperators), how long it's kept, and how users understand and control it.

 - Design how Memo behaves and communicates around kids, pets, and unexpected situations — stop conditions, warnings, recovery, and what the app tells users.

 - Set standards where none exist. Draw on adjacent industries (consumer durables, home fitness equipment, new category products, appliances) to build a safety framework fit for a home robot — without importing process that doesn't apply.

 - Run incident review. When something goes wrong in a home or the office, lead the investigation, root cause, and the change that follows.

 - Partner with product operations to turn real-home observations into safety requirements.

 - Define and track safety metrics: incidents per robot-hour, near-misses, test coverage by subsystem, time-to-mitigation.

What You'll Bring

 - 3+ years in product, safety, or quality roles on physical consumer products people touch and live with — think new category products, home fitness equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, or similar. You've shipped hardware into homes where the standards were thin and you had to set them.

 - Not required: automotive, aerospace, or medical device background. While this is nice to have, we're looking for judgment in lightly regulated spaces, not fluency in pre-existing regulatory frameworks.

 - Detail-oriented. You read the test report, not the summary. You notice the edge case nobody listed.

 - Fast technical learner. You can pick up how a navigation stack, a controller, or a firmware release process works well enough to ask the right questions and spot gaps.

 - Strong judgment and a deep sense of responsibility. You'll make calls that affect families, and you treat that seriously. You're comfortable being the person who says "not yet."

 - Experience working with engineers on test plans, failure analysis, or release gating.

 - Familiarity with data privacy principles for connected consumer devices (cameras, in-home sensors).

 - Comfort with ambiguity at an early-stage company. You can write the first version of a safety standard that doesn't exist yet.

 - Bonus: experience with consumer product safety standards (ASTM, UL, CPSC), in-home cameras or robots, or incident/recall processes.

What success looks like in 6 months

 - Memo has a written, system-level safety framework with owners and test coverage for every subsystem, used as a release gate.

 - Every firmware/software release passes a defined safety validation before OTA.

 - Data privacy policy for in-home recording and teleop is defined, implemented in the app, and understandable to users.

 - An incident review process is running, and beta learnings are feeding back into requirements.

 - Product, hardware, and engineering leads treat the T&S PM as the owner of "is this safe to ship."



At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

jobs.title: Driver Support Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT 8FLEET

8Fleet is a rapidly growing technology and logistics startup building the operational infrastructure for both autonomous and non-autonomous rideshare fleets. As we expand into new markets, we're looking for a Driver Support Specialist to help our Head of Central Operations make sure every driver who reaches out gets a fast, accurate, and well-written answer.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Central Operations owns the processes and programs that run across every 8Fleet market, and driver support is one of the clearest windows into how that operation is working. Every ticket is a driver telling us where something broke, from onboarding to shift to vehicle handoff to pay.

As a Driver Support Specialist, you'll work our Zendesk queue day to day: resolving tickets, getting escalations to the right team, and following through until each one is closed. You'll also help us answer faster and more consistently by building macros and template responses, so drivers get clear, accurate, on-brand replies every time.

This is an on-site role at our Los Angeles HQ.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Work the Zendesk Queue: Triage, prioritize, and resolve driver tickets with accuracy, speed, and care.

 - Communicate Clearly: Write clear, professional responses to drivers, with the right tone for every situation.

 - Build Consistency: Create and maintain macros, template responses, and tags in Zendesk so answers stay consistent and repeat issues take less time.

 - Route Escalations: Hand off issues to the right internal teams, including HR, payroll, maintenance, and market operations, and follow up until they are resolved.

 - Track the Numbers: Monitor response and resolution times and flag backlog or recurring issues early.

 - Spot Patterns: Identify ticket trends and share what drivers are telling us with Central Operations.

 - Keep Content Current: Keep support documentation and help content accurate as policies and markets change.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in customer or driver support, ideally in a rideshare, delivery, or marketplace environment.

 - Excellent written communication: strong grammar, a good ear for tone, and the ability to turn common questions into clear template responses.

 - Strong follow-through on tickets and across teams, and comfort reaching out to HR, payroll, and other internal partners to get answers for drivers.

 - Empathy for drivers and sound judgment on when to resolve, when to escalate, and when to suggest a process change.

 - A bias toward action and comfort figuring things out without a playbook.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on Zendesk experience, including macros and views.

 - Experience working in a Greenlight Hub (Uber Greenlight activation hub) or a similar driver-facing support environment.


COMPENSATION

 - $24/hour


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

8Fleet is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketer (Veterinarians)
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower veterinary professionals with opportunities to achieve greater flexibility in their careers while helping animal hospitals provide care for more pets in their communities.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the leading veterinary staffing and careers platform, connecting Vets, Techs, and Veterinary Assistants with practices for relief support, full-time hiring, and free continuing education. Roo empowers the largest network of over 30,000 veterinary professionals to earn and learn on their schedule, helping Veterinarians earn over $400 million. Together, we’ve provided more than 5 million hours of coverage at over 10,000 animal hospitals.

About the Role

As the Growth Marketer for Roo's Veterinary Marketplace, you own how veterinarians find Roo, why they sign up, and what gets them from a new account to their first shift.

This is a technical growth role. You run paid like a performance marketer, think about activation like a growth PM, pull your own data like an analyst, and build your own tools with AI like an engineer. One person, all four.

It is a senior IC seat in the Veterinary Marketplace Business Unit. Your time splits about evenly between acquisition and activation. You are held to vets who work, not leads or sign-ups.

The problem is a hard one. There are only tens of thousands of relief vets in the country, and about half have already signed up. You can't buy the rest. Of the vets we approve, 1 in 4 request a shift in their first week, and that number has not moved in over a year. We know the reasons. Nobody has fixed them one at a time and measured what moves. That is the job.

You report to the GM of the Veterinary Marketplace BU, with a dotted line to the Chief of Marketing, and you are part of Roo's marketing guild, which owns craft standards across the company.

Your Responsibilities

• Own vet acquisition strategy and budget: channel mix, spend by market and audience, CPA and payback targets.

• Run vet paid media strategy and performance, directing a shared agency partner on day-to-day execution.

• Lead vet AEO, and set priorities and briefs for SEO and the website with the brand team.

• Build the tools, agents and automations the funnel needs, yourself. Whatever gets vets in the door.

• Own the referral program end to end: offer, mechanics, payouts, fraud controls and promotion.

• Plan and launch vet-only acquisition campaigns, and bring the acquisition layer to company-wide moments led by the brand team.

• Set and manage the CRO backlog and test calendar for the sign-up flow and landing pages.

• Help Onboarding get newly approved vets to request their first shift in their first week.

• Own the acquisition model of record: CPA by channel, cohort activation, LTV, payback, and the holdout standard every program is measured against.

• Define the handoffs with Onboarding and Business Development: lead lists, lead scoring inputs and handoff rules. Onboarding sells the first shift request; vets with no request after about a week move to BD.

• Partner with the events team to improve sign-ups from in-person events.

• Co-own the BU strategy with the GM and Staff PM, and report progress, spend and learnings to leadership.

How this role works with the team

With the Staff PM: the Staff PM owns the product: verification, approval, the first-shift experience, and the price boost and promotion engine. You own who we reach, what we offer, and what we say. Where the funnel crosses from one to the other, you work as a pair: one target, one experiment roadmap.

With the Lifecycle Marketer: once a vet is in our database, the channel to them belongs to lifecycle. You write the activation briefs and bring the acquisition insight; they own the journeys and the build.

Qualifications

• Acquisition depth. 5+ years in growth or performance marketing, owning a budget and a channel mix. Supply-side marketplace or licensed-professional experience is a plus.

• Outcome ownership. You have been held to a number downstream of the click and changed your spend because of it.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Machining & Additive Associate (Winter 2027)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Manufacturing Engineer, Machining Associate (Winter 2027)

This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of hands-on machining and high-level process ownership creating complex, precision hardware for space.

As an Associate, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on challenging projects, no matter their seniority. Many past Interns and Associates have designed and tested hardware/software that is heading to space on our first satellite, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis.

The Manufacturing Engineer focused on machining owns the entire lifecycle of our machined and additively manufactured components — from working closely with the mechanical engineering team to ensure parts are designed for manufacturability to developing production processes, tooling, and inspection procedures on the factory floor. The Manufacturing Engineer is a highly cross-functional role requiring both technical and hands on skills to bridge the gap between design and production.

A successful candidate will apply knowledge of GD&T, 5axis CNC machining, additive manufacturing, and CMM inspection to solve difficult problems in real time and drive improvements that directly impact our ability to get to space faster.

Role

• Design and build the factory that builds satellites.

• Grow and improve

• Design and implement lean systems for continuous improvement.

• Own 5S activities throughout the machine shop and additive manufacturing spaces.

• Work with design engineering teams to drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM), including participating in design reviews and assisting in tolerance stackup analysis.

• Develop and qualify manufacturing and inspection processes, including performing process validation, documenting procedures, and supporting processes in production.

• Operate, maintain, and develop processes for our in-house additive manufacturing capabilities, including Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) metal and advanced polymer printing systems.

• Write work instructions, work order templates, process specifications, and other build documents.

• Work with supplier quality and contract manufacturers, to develop their manufacturing and quality processes and respond to questions and issues.

• Troubleshoot non-conformances on the floor to determine a disposition, root cause, and drive corrective actions.

• Assist in machining and programming operations as required for R&D and production.

• Assist in designing and creating fixturing for production.

Requirements

• Hands on experience making something cool such as cars, robots, etc.

• Hands on experience machining parts, either manual or CNC.

• Proficiency in CAD software (Solidworks, Creo, NX, etc.)

• Experience with CAM software (Fusion, Esprit, Siemens NX, Magics, or similar).

• Competent in fundamentals of GD&T and engineering drawings.

Bonus

• Hands on experience working as a Machinist programming and running 5-axis parts.

• Exposure to or hands-on experience with additive manufacturing technologies, specifically metal LPBF and/or advanced polymer printing.

• Experience in writing technical documents.

• Knowledge of different manufacturing process and their general quality capability.

• Mechanical design experience including creating solid models and prints.

• Hands-on experience reading and interpreting first article inspection reports, using precision hand tools, and implementing tolerance stackup analysis on parts.

jobs.title: Second Shift Senior Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.



What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will maintain production equipment used to build high-voltage capacitors and integrated modules for Helion’s fusion reactor systems. You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues, perform preventive and corrective maintenance, restore equipment safely, and improve equipment readiness.

This is an onsite role in Everett, WA reporting to the Supervisor of Technical Maintenance, and may require schedule flexibility as operations grow toward multi-shift and eventual 24/7 coverage.

You Will

 - Maintain and repair automated and industrial production equipment, including high-voltage test systems, laser welding equipment, soldering equipment, material handling equipment, pumps, presses, conveyors, and related systems.

 - Work safely around industrial hazards including high voltage, stored energy, pressurized systems, lasers, and robotic equipment using established safety controls such as LOTO and electrical safe work practices.

 - Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, and basic controls issues using schematics, manuals, OEM documentation, maintenance history, and structured escalation.

 - Install, replace, and repair common electrical and mechanical components such as sensors, relays, contactors, motors, bearings, belts, gearboxes, pumps, valves, and seals.

 - Document work in a CMMS or similar maintenance system, including labor, failures, repairs, parts, and equipment history.

 - Support emergency repairs and reliability improvement by identifying failure modes, needed tools and spares, return-to-service checks, and opportunities to improve PM quality, uptime, MTTR, and equipment readiness.

 - Other duties as required.



Required Skills

 - Able to support a second shift schedule 2:00pm to 10:30 pm Monday through Friday.

 - 5+ years of relevant hands-on technical maintenance experience. Relevant backgrounds may include industrial or manufacturing maintenance, equipment service, military maintenance, aviation, automotive diagnostics, field service, or machine building.

 - High school diploma or equivalent required; technical degree, apprenticeship, military technical training, or formal controls training may be considered in place of some direct experience.

 - Electro-mechanical troubleshooting capability, with depth in either electrical or mechanical systems and safe working ability across both.

 - Ability to troubleshoot industrial electrical and mechanical systems such as 480V equipment, motors, drives, sensors, power distribution, safety circuits, bearings, belts, gearboxes, pumps, valves, pneumatics, hydraulics, tooling, and mechanical assemblies.

 - Ability to perform basic controls troubleshooting, including fault codes, sensor and actuator checks, field device replacement, and escalation of programming, logic, robot, HMI, or drive configuration issues.

 - Ability to read and use schematics, manuals, OEM documentation, work instructions, and maintenance records to troubleshoot equipment.

 - Ability to document maintenance activity in a CMMS or similar work order system and support critical equipment issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 - Ability to work assigned schedules as operations evolve, including day, swing, night, rotating, overtime, weekend, or on-call coverage as needed.

 - Ability to lift up to 49 pounds unassisted, stand and walk during shifts up to 12 hours, and regularly bend, lift, stretch, and reach below the waist and above the head.

#LI-ONSITE #LI-SA1

Benefits

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families 

 - 31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days) 

 - 10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break 

 - Up to 5% employer 401(k) match 

 - Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance 

 - Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks) 

 - Annual wellness stipend

Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
