jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
About Abacum



Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.



Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.



We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.



Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our People team and support our growing North American organization.

This is a hands-on People Operations role with ownership across the US and Canada, with a strong focus on payroll, employee lifecycle management, compliance, benefits, office management, and operational execution.

You will manage key People processes from the moment an employee joins through onboarding, payroll, employee changes, leaves and off-boarding, ensuring every process is accurate, compliant and well documented.

A key part of this role is managing payroll operations across both the US and Canada, so we are looking for someone who already understands the operational requirements of working across both countries and can confidently partner with payroll providers, Finance and external advisors.

You will work closely with the Global People Manager, Finance, external payroll providers and managers across the company.

Note that this is a hybrid role in our beautiful Midtown office Tuesday-Thursday.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Employee lifecycle

Own People Operations across the full employee lifecycle for employees in the US and Canada, including onboarding, employee changes, leaves, documentation and off-boarding.

Ensure employee records and documentation remain accurate and consistent across systems.



US & Canada payroll

Own the operational preparation and review of payroll across both the United States and Canada.

Manage payroll inputs including new hires, terminations, salary changes, variable compensation, benefits and other employee changes.

Partner with payroll providers and Finance to ensure every payroll cycle is accurate, compliant and completed on time.

Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies and continuously improve payroll processes.



People Operations & compliance

Act as an operational point of reference for employees and managers across the US and Canada on payroll, benefits, PTO, leaves, employee documentation and People processes.

Maintain awareness of relevant employment requirements across both countries and coordinate with external advisors when specialist guidance is needed.

Translate regulatory requirements into practical and scalable internal processes.

You will be the go-to representative for the People team in the NYC office and will need to provide on the ground support for the CEO and Chief of Staff.



Onboarding & off-boarding

Coordinate onboarding requirements, employment documentation and operational setup for new hires.

Manage voluntary and involuntary employee exits, including payroll, benefits, documentation and system updates.

Ensure every transition is handled accurately, consistently and with the appropriate level of care and compliance.



HR systems, data & documentation

Maintain accurate employee data across our HR systems and internal tools.

Own recurring People Operations workflows and documentation.

Build and maintain clear SOPs and scalable processes.

Identify opportunities to simplify or automate manual processes.



Benefits & employee support

Support the administration of employee benefits across the US and Canada.

Act as a trusted point of contact for employees on People Operations questions.

Provide clear and practical guidance while maintaining confidentiality, consistency and professional judgement.




ABOUT YOU

You are a hands-on People Operations professional who enjoys making complex operational processes work smoothly.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working across different employment frameworks, providers and jurisdictions.

You understand the operational differences between the US and Canada and are confident managing payroll and employee lifecycle processes across both countries.

You are comfortable taking ownership independently while working closely with the broader People team.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on payroll experience in both the US and Canada is essential.

 - 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations or a similar generalist role.

 - Strong experience managing employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, compensation changes, leaves and offboarding.

 - Practical knowledge of US and Canadian People Operations, including payroll, benefits, employment documentation and leave administration.

 - Experience working with external payroll providers, PEOs, or similar partners.

 - Strong HR systems, data and process mindset.

 - Strong judgement and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive employee matters.

 - Comfortable taking ownership and improving processes in a fast-growing international environment.




WHY THIS ROLE

You will join a lean People team at a stage where our North American presence is growing quickly.

You will have real ownership over the operational foundations behind how we onboard, pay, support and off-board employees across the US and Canada, while helping us build processes that can scale with the company.



Benefits

 - Competitive compensation including equity package

 - Competitive vacation policy

 - Medical Insurance

 - L&D budget

 - Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

 - Language courses (English / Spanish)



Our Values


Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.



Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.



Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.



Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.



Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.




JOB OVERVIEW

As a Material Planner, you’ll own the flow of material that keeps every Heron Link build on schedule. In this hands-on role, you’ll get the right parts to the right place at the right time, whether that means on site, kitted, or shipped to our suppliers, contract manufacturers, and rework partners. You’ll partner closely with Supply Chain, Desgin Engineering, NPI, Manufacturing and Warehouse to track purchase orders, surface risks early, and keep inventory records accurate as we scale our operations.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Own Clear To Build (CTB) for each NPI build, leading daily review with the supply chain team, tracking POs and shipments.

 - Manage the constrained parts Heron Power buys and supplies to its suppliers and Contract Manufacturers (CMs).

 - Build automated alerts to escalate late or at-risk parts and drive corrective actions with partner teams before they impact the build.

 - Collaborate with the warehouse team to ensure parts are received correctly against POs and stored in an organized, labeled location.

 - Manage rework material, from defining BOMs and kitting parts with engineers to shipping and tracking PCBAs from rework sites.

 - Partner with our in-house software team to build/improve material ordering and inventory tracking system




WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We’re looking for an organized, hands-on self-starter who’s eager to learn in a fast-paced hardware environment. Scope and responsibilities will grow with the right candidate.




MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

 - 2 to 4 years of experience in materials, supply chain, production planning, or purchasing, ideally in hardware manufacturing

 - Comfortable reading BOMs, purchase orders, and shipping documents

 - Experience with CTB reports, MRP, and kitting

 - Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets (filters, lookups, basic formulas)

 - Strong attention to detail and a habit of keeping records accurate

 - Clear communicator who escalates problems early


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with an ERP or MRP system (for example NetSuite, Odoo, or SAP)

 - Experience supporting NPI builds or coordinating with a contract manufacturer

 - Exposure to electronics manufacturing: reels, trays, ESD handling, and moisture-sensitive (MSL) parts

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The base salary range for the role is from $85,000 to $115,000.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer (Vulnerability Management)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SECURITY ENGINEER (VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT)

SpaceX is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer to join Information Security to help protect and drive the SpaceX mission. Information drives our business. We must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise, and defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems.

Information drives our business and we must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise. As a highly visible and dynamic organization, we must also value and guard against damage to our reputation and brand. It is paramount that we defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems, to guarantee the highest probability of success.

As a member of the SpaceX Vulnerability Management team, the Security Engineer will act as a trusted partner to application software development teams. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities and threats while developing and maintaining internal security tools. The role also includes hands-on work triaging bug reports, conducting Purple and Red Team activities, and continuous threat hunting. Strong communication skills and the ability to turn technical findings into practical, actionable guidance are essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Development of tools, processes, and guidance that make security easier to adopt without slowing delivery.

• Conduct software code reviews to identify insecure patterns and help teams remediate issues.

• Perform web application security testing using established frameworks and tools.

• Triage and validate Bugcrowd reports, coordinate with researchers, and work directly with internal teams on remediation and disclosure.

• Perform Purple Team exercises to test controls, improve detection, and close identified gaps.

• Contribute to Red Team operations or simulations, including scoping, execution support, and post-exercise analysis.

• Build and operate emerging vulnerability communication processes so teams receive timely, actionable alerts on new threats.

• Conduct continuous threat assessment by folding threat intelligence, emerging vulnerabilities, and attack trends into scanning coverage, notifications, and prioritization.

• Partner with other security sub-teams (detection/response, compliance, application security, infrastructure) to keep efforts consistent and reduce duplication.

• Escalate critical or time-sensitive issues promptly while offering practical mitigation options.

• Document findings, produce metrics, and provide regular risk summaries to leadership.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience operating production infrastructure and high school diploma or equivalency certificate in lieu of a degree.

• 5+ years of experience operating on-premises Kubernetes in a production environment.

• 5+ years of experience with Linux system administration and with Python, Go, or another language used to automate infrastructure.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities (applications, infrastructure, or cloud).

• Experience working directly with engineering teams to close findings.

• Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) and the ability to develop internal tools.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls) and how they relate to vulnerability exposure.

• Reverse engineering or vulnerability development experience.

• Experience triaging or working reports from bug bounty platforms (Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or similar).

• Hands-on participation in Purple Team or Red Team exercises.

• OT Security Experience.

• Experience with continuous threat assessment, threat intelligence, or risk-based vulnerability prioritization.

• Experience developing internal security tools, dashboards, or automation pipelines (production-quality code, integrations, etc.).

• Experience with web application testing frameworks and tools.

• Experience performing software code reviews for security issues.

• Experience improving developer experience around security tooling and processes.

• Knowledge of network segmentation principles and implementation.

• Experience with asset discovery or inventory processes.

• Experience building or operating emerging vulnerability notification/alerting workflows.

• Familiarity with AI/LLMs and MCPs.

• Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their native security/vulnerability features.

• Experience with configuration management, patching, or infrastructure-as-code.

• Knowledge of threat modeling, risk scoring (e.g., CVSS), and prioritization frameworks.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Sales Compensation Analyst supports the design, modeling, administration, documentation, and governance of Trace3's sales incentive compensation programs. Reporting to the Director, Sales Compensation & Planning, this role delivers the analysis, plan documentation, and reporting that underpin incentive plan decisions across all go-to-market segments.

The analyst will work closely with GTM Strategy & Operations, Finance, and Sales Leadership to ensure compensation programs are accurately documented, well governed, and aligned with pay-for-performance outcomes.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Support the design and annual refresh of sales incentive plans, including commissions, SPIFFs, overrides, accelerators, and MBO components, by gathering requirements, preparing analysis, and drafting plan materials for review by the Director.

• Build and maintain financial models that forecast plan costs, payout scenarios, attainment distributions, and pay-for-performance outcomes. Run scenario analyses on proposed plan changes and summarize business impacts prior to implementation.

• Draft and maintain sales compensation plan documents, policies, crediting rules, and participant plan agreements, and keep the sales incentive plan document library current.

• Administer the incentive plan governance workflow, including tracking plan approvals, documenting exception requests, logging plan changes, and maintaining a complete audit trail of plan decisions.

• Support quota setting, territory planning, and account coverage analysis through data analysis, modeling, and validation of capacity assumptions across go-to-market segments.

• Develop and maintain recurring incentive compensation reports and dashboards that measure attainment distribution, plan effectiveness, participant behavior, and return on incentive spend.

• Respond to questions from sellers and sales leaders on plan interpretation and crediting rules, escalating complex or precedent-setting matters to the Director.

• Partner with Payroll, Finance, Revenue Operations, and systems teams to ensure incentive plans are accurately configured within downstream systems. This role supports plan governance and administration and does not directly calculate, approve, or disburse incentive payments.

• Prepare analysis and materials for recurring business reviews with GTM and Finance leadership on program performance and recommended enhancements.

• Support the annual sales compensation planning cycle by managing timelines, tracking deliverables, and preparing plan design inputs aligned with segmentation strategy and revenue growth objectives.

• Maintain documentation and controls, and prepare supporting materials for internal and external audits of sales incentive compensation programs.

• Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting automation, and process efficiency across sales compensation programs.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 3-5 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, finance, compensation, or related analytical disciplines, including experience supporting incentive plan design, financial modeling, or sales performance analysis.

• Working knowledge of sales incentive plan components, including commissions, SPIFFs, overrides, accelerators, quotas, and crediting rules.

• Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, quota attainment reporting, compensation effectiveness measures, and key go-to-market performance indicators.

• Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to build scenario models, interpret results, and summarize findings clearly.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and data modeling. Experience with CRM, ERP, and Sales Performance Management (SPM) platforms preferred.

• Familiarity with quota setting, territory planning, account coverage models, and go-to-market segmentation.

• Experience developing reports, dashboards, and executive-ready analyses to support compensation, sales, and financial decision-making.

• Exceptional attention to detail, with a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation, and process discipline.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines, particularly during the annual planning cycle.

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and executive stakeholders.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain compensation concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Experience within a technology, value-added reseller (VAR), distribution, or similar sales-driven environment preferred.

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

$70,000—$80,000 USD

The Perks

• Competitive Compensation

• Training and development programs

• Collaborative and cool culture

Our Commitment

At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. jobs.title: Growth Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Revenue Strategy & Operations team is responsible for driving revenue generation across the business by informing business strategy, improving operational efficiency, and delivering data-driven insights. This role requires cross-functional collaboration across business development, finance, engineering, operations, planning, and production teams. Given our rapid growth and the uniquely challenging problems we tackle as a business, this role will naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and will be adept at navigating organizational hurdles. The ability to build trust quickly in a fast-paced environment and execute with high dependability is critical to success in this role.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Growth Operations Associate to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa. In this role, you will be responsible for partnering across the business to design scalable processes, drive operational excellent, and optimize tools and systems that support our growth team. You will inform business strategy and deliver data-driven insights that enable revenue generation across the organization. This will require strong analytical skills, a knack for process improvement, and experience working with cross-functional teams. If you are someone who communicates effectively, takes initiative, and thrives in a high-growth, fast changing environment then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• System Design

• Proactively identify and address recurring business challenges, innovating and iterating on processes to foster long-term solutions

• Project manage from start to finish the rollout of new systems and features (including discovery, builds, testing, communications, and roll-out)

• Collaborate closely with Business Development, Corporate Technology, Financial Operations, and Divisional Operations teams to refine and improve systems and processes to scale effectively

• Design workflows that hold up under real-world pressure: multi-year procurement cycles, classified program constraints, multiple stakeholders touching the same account

• Serve as a trusted advisor on best practices for growth systems (ie Salesforce), championing data integrity and governance standards

• Architect how opportunities get created, staged, and tracked from first contact through close - spanning CRM (Salesforce), COCOM/government account structures, and cross-business line/cross-department handoff

• Build the reporting layer that gives leadership an accurate, real-time read on pipeline health without a weekly manual roll-up

• Documentation & Enablement

• Write the process documentation that makes “how we track a deal” unambiguous - RACI charts, stage-gate definitions, field-level data standards

• Design and deliver onboarding and training programs to support the effectiveness of our growth teams and enforce the adoption of best practices across all business lines

• Build and deliver training for sales, business development, and finance teams on new tools and processes - live sessions, quick reference guides to drive adoption of best practices across all business lines.

• Maintain a living playbook that gets updated as fast as the org changes, not once a year

• Enforcement & Governance

• Own data quality and process adherence - build the audits, nudges, and escalation paths that keep the CRM trustworthy

• Partner with team leads to hold their teams accountable to the standard

• Identify where a broken process is a training gap versus a system gap and fix the right one.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3-5 years experience in consulting, finance/revenue operations, sales/growth operations, ideally somewhere with real process complexity (e.g., multiple business lines, various types of deals and sales cycles, and government/commercial accounts)

• Deep Salesforce fluency and experience - have built or heavily customized instances, not just reported out of them

• Experience creating documentation and training that people actually use and reference

• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.

• Comfort holding senior stakeholders accountable to a process, diplomatically and firmly

• Project management experience including: requirements gathering, analysis, design, testing, deployment, training, and delivery.

• Aptitude for rapid learning and assimilating new information to swiftly become proficient in unfamiliar subject areas and technologies.

• Strong organizational skills with experience managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment

• Bias towards building the process or system over writing the memo proposing it

• Ownership mentality with a natural bias to assume responsibility. We empower our team to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own projects and shape their success.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

Bonus: Experience with government/defense cycles, COCOM or DoD Account structures, and post-acquisition system integration.

US Salary Range

$117,000—$150,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer - Hybrid
jobs.description:

The position also supports faculty and academic teams by applying instructional design best practices and facilitating continuous improvement in course delivery.

• Design and develop courses within the institution’s Learning Management System (LMS) to ensure high-quality student learning experience.
• Create engaging instructional content including course overviews, syllabi, learning outcomes, multimedia activities, and assessments.
• Build and publish eLearning modules that integrate interactive elements and align with course outcomes.
• Collaborate closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) to translate technical or specialized knowledge into engaging, student-centered learning experiences. Guide SMEs in applying instructional best practices, align content with program outcomes, and ensure materials are accurate, accessible, and pedagogically sound.
• Apply evidence-based instructional strategies grounded in adult learning theory and best practices for higher education.
• Ensure curriculum alignment by participating in committee meetings and integrating approved updates into course design.
• Review and revise instructional materials to maintain accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with institutional and regulatory standards.
• Document and maintain course resources while contributing to shared training and knowledgebase materials.
• Pilot and evaluate new learning technologies and recommend appropriate tools for adoption.
• Stay current with instructional design trends and apply knowledge of accessibility, copyright, and compliance requirements.
• Support continuous improvement by gathering feedback, analyzing outcomes, and suggesting course enhancements.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

*Please note that this position is hybrid at our Tempe Corporate Office

• Master’s degree in instructional design, instructional technology, or related field.
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience designing and delivering higher education courses.
• Proficiency with instructional technology and multimedia authoring tools.
• Strong knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models.

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.



We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. Job: You will own the NYC office. Parallel’s New York team works out of NeueHouse Madison Square, and your job is to make it feel like ours. You’ll run the in-person side of hiring and onboarding: candidate onsites, Day 1 for new hires, guests and visitors. Everyone who walks in should leave with the right impression. jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer - Sentry
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Supplier Quality Engineer on the Sentry products team, you will work inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality and reliable products for Anduril's Sentry autonomous surveillance systems and the critical components that make successful sourcing solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, quality, and performance of components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's core commodity families — PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging — that enable Sentry to operate in demanding field environments. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers, and partnering with them for world-class results is essential across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing across multiple commodity types, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria and metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout the product development stages with the Sentry product engineering team through design reviews, supplier process development, testing, and qualification for components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's commodity families: PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging. Review supplier processes and capabilities to ensure alignment to product, part, and sub-assembly requirements.

• Provide technical expertise for manufacturing and outsourcing processes across commodities — including printed circuit board assemblies, structural and power systems, radar modules, and imaging sensor assemblies. Drive the gathering of data and insights from suppliers to conduct top-tier evaluations of manufacturability, quality, cost-efficiency, capability, and audit compliance.

• Partner with development engineering (mechanical, electrical, RF, and optical/systems), product quality engineering, and program management to deliver predictable supply to Sentry development programs and production programs, and manage exceptions, containments, and deviations for supplier technical performance.

• Drive supplier quality readiness by analyzing key and critical characteristics for drawings, schematics, and supplier specifications, develop measurement systems and inspection criteria, and lead supplier qualification activities (PPAP, FAIR, MSA, Audit, inspection development, PFMEA & AS9102, etc.).

• Partner with Category Management and Sourcing Engineering to drive overall supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and fulfillment of strategic goals across all four commodity families.

• Own the elimination of supplier risk to improve quality and reliability across the Sentry product lifecycle, from early prototyping through scaled production. Utilize audits, readiness reviews, and training and documentation to ensure compliance.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the technology/vendor capability roadmap and delivery schedules needed for future Sentry variants, proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and explorations.

• Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) and Material Review Board (MRB) activities. Review supplier effectiveness of actions and share lessons learned across the Sentry product team. Drive supplier corrective action and response (SCAR) process.

• Audit the Quality Management System at our suppliers as it pertains to supplier quality and performance. Define and improve required documentation and activities as needed to ensure Anduril's compliance to flow-down requirements from customers.

• Prepare, support, and lead supplier onsite audits and reviews for contract deliverables for quality management and compliance.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar technical field (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred)

• Experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in aerospace/defense or similar hardware across one or more of the following commodities: PCBA, structures and power, radar, or imaging

• Experience driving high quality assembly and/or disassembly of complex projects and mechanical or electronic structures through developing drawings, schematics, and work instructions with other engineering functions

• Experience with driving supplier performance and evaluation. Experience with Statement of Work (SOW), quality clauses, intellectual property (IP), and government regulations such as ITAR, etc.

• Working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) elements such as Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) quality improvement techniques, and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

• A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion

• Analytical skills and experience with data mining, data quality, metrics generation, issue management systems, and statistical analysis tools (MatLab, JMP, MiniTab, etc.)

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. TS/SCI security clearance

• Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time to suppliers, sourcing partners, and manufacturing locations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in a technical field

• 5–7 years of experience with developing quality systems for low volume, high complexity manufacturing environments and suppliers

• Experience across multiple Sentry commodity families (PCBA, structures and power, radar, imaging)

• Working knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001) and AS9100/ISO 9001-based Quality Management System requirements

• Experience with government contracts and MIL standard requirements

• Experience with Teamcenter, SolidWorks, Oracle/Netsuite, Jira, Tableau, and Foundry

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Food Safety & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Food Safety & Quality Manager is responsible for leading and maintaining the facility’s food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance programs. This position ensures that citrus juice, concentrates, pulp cells, and related products consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and company standards. The manager works collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to promote food safety, product consistency, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Here's what you'll do:

Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance

• Develop, implement, and maintain the Food Safety Management System (FSMS), HACCP plans, and prerequisite programs.
• Ensure compliance with FDA regulations, customer requirements, and applicable food safety certification standards.
• Lead food safety audits, inspections, risk assessments, investigations, and corrective actions.
• Maintain effective sanitation, environmental monitoring, pest control, and product traceability programs.
• This role is the audit representative for the company.

Quality Assurance & Process Control

• Establish and maintain product specifications, quality standards, testing procedures, and product release requirements.
• Oversee quality control throughout extraction, processing, pasteurization, concentration, storage, and shipment.
• Monitor product characteristics, including Brix, acidity, color, flavor, microbiological quality, and pulp content.
• Manage nonconforming products, customer complaints, product holds, and corrective actions.
• Partner with Operations to improve product consistency, reduce quality losses, and optimize processing performance.

Laboratory & Technical Management

• Direct laboratory operations, analytical testing, sampling procedures, and equipment calibration.
• Ensure accurate, reliable, and timely reporting of quality and food safety data.
• Maintain testing documentation, Certificates of Analysis, and product records.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

• Lead, develop, and hold accountable quality assurance and laboratory personnel.
• Establish performance expectations, training programs, and a strong facility-wide food safety culture.
• Drive root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Utilize data, technology, automation, and process standardization to improve quality, efficiency, and cost performance.
• Collaborate with plant leadership to identify risks, implement improvements, and achieve operational objectives.

Performance Management & Customer Relations

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators for food safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, and cost of poor quality.
• Manage customer specifications, quality complaints, audits, and technical communications.
• Provide timely performance reporting and recommendations to plant leadership.
• Manage departmental resources, laboratory expenses, and quality-related costs.

Here's what you'll bring to the table:

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in food manufacturing quality assurance or food safety, preferably in citrus or beverage processing.
• Demonstrated knowledge of Juice HACCP, FDA FSMA regulations, GMPs, sanitation, and food safety management systems.
• Experience leading teams, managing audits, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.
• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
• Proficiency in quality data analysis, reporting systems, and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop; talk or hear; and taste or smell. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

Key Performance Expectations

• Maintain regulatory compliance and effective food safety controls.
• Improve first-pass product quality and reduce customer complaints.
• Reduce quality-related product losses, rework, and operating costs.
• Ensure timely completion of corrective actions, audits, and employee training.
• Strengthen data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across the facility.
• This position may require long hours during the fruit season. Including working weekends and nights.

Wonderful's dedication to you:

• Continued training and generous Education Reimbursement Program
• Paid sick, vacation and holiday time
• Wonderful Giving (www.wonderfulgiving.com) -- allowing you to donate company money to a cause of your choice

Wonderful Citrus is part of The Wonderful Company, a privately held $6 billion global company dedicated to harvesting health and happiness around the world. Its iconic brands include FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, Wonderful Pistachios, Wonderful Halos, Wonderful Seedless Lemons, Teleflora, and JUSTIN and Lewis Cellars wines. The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back in its DNA.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Lead Product Manager for Agentic Commerce, you'll define what agentic payments and rewards look like at Imprint, then go build it. This is a zero-to-one role: you'll run a small skunkworks team that ships in tight increments, puts new products in front of real users fast, and lets the market tell us what works.

We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply fluent in payments, and genuinely obsessed with AI agents. You don't just follow the space; you use agents every day and build with them yourself.

Agentic Commerce is a small, high-autonomy team inside Imprint's payments organization. It operates like a startup within the company: few dependencies, short cycles, and a bias toward shipping something real over polishing a plan.

You'll report to the product leader for Payments, Risk and Customer Operations, and partner day to day with engineers on our payments and messaging platform. You'll also work closely with partnerships, risk, compliance and our brand partners to turn experiments into products that can run at scale.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for agentic commerce at Imprint, from how agents initiate and authorize payments to how cardholders use agents to earn and redeem rewards.

 - Run a fast build-measure-learn loop: frame a bet, ship the smallest version that tests it, read the signal, and decide whether to scale, pivot or kill it.

 - Prototype hands-on with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor and similar) to get from idea to something users can touch in days, not quarters.

 - Get close to the power users who already use agents to optimize their spending and rewards, and turn what you learn into products they'd pay attention to.

 - Track the agentic payments ecosystem (network and wallet agent programs, agent payment protocols, tokenization) and decide where Imprint should build, partner or wait.

 - Work with risk, compliance and our bank partners to design agent-initiated payment flows that are safe and auditable from day one.

 - Make the case for what's working to leadership and brand partners, and help shape how Imprint takes agentic products to market.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 90 days: you've talked to dozens of power users and partners, picked the first two or three bets, and shipped at least one experiment to real users.

 - First 6 months: a repeatable cadence of small releases, with clear evidence on which agentic use cases drive engagement, spend or rewards value.

 - First 12 months: at least one agentic product live with brand partners, and a point of view on agentic commerce that shapes Imprint's broader product strategy.


YOUR PROFILE

 - 8+ years building products, as a product manager, founder or both, with a track record of taking something from zero to real usage.

 - Strong payments experience: card networks, issuing, acquiring, tokenization, wallets or money movement. You understand how a transaction actually flows and where the hard problems live.

 - Demonstrated high agency in ambiguous environments. You've been handed a blank page with no team, playbook or clear owner and delivered measurable impact anyway.

 - A genuine, hands-on passion for AI agents, shown through what you've built, shipped or tinkered with, not just what you've read.

 - Fluency with core LLM and agent concepts (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails) and the judgment to turn them into reliable products that handle real money.

 - Comfort prototyping with modern AI-native tools and working directly in code alongside engineers.

 - Clear, concise communication. You can explain a complex system to an engineer, a bank partner and an executive in the same afternoon.

We care more about what you've done than how your resume is titled. If you meet most of these and are excited by the role, we encourage you to apply.




BONUS POINTS

 - You've founded a company, ideally after starting your career as a PM, and spent time building in payments along the way.

 - You were the first PM at an early-stage startup.

 - You've built or shipped an agent, agent integration or agentic payments product.

 - Experience with credit cards, rewards or loyalty programs.

 - You're a rewards optimizer yourself, and you already have agents doing some of that work for you.


LEARN MORE

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog: https://tech.imprint.co/




PERKS & BENEFITS

jobs.title: Director of FP&A and Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
ABOUT GOODR

We create and sell active eyewear for anyone. No Slip. No Bounce. All Polarized. All Fun. Interested in joining our team? Keep reading.

OUR VALUES: We have two core values: Fun & Authenticity.

• FUN = Being sh*tty isn’t fun. Agreed? Taking pride in your work, finding joy in being GREAT, and celebrating wins… and losses. Now, that’s fun!

• AUTHENTICITY = Focusing on being authentic over being liked. (Next-level guru stuff. Count it.)

Fun Fact: We do not allow email to be sent internally. Carrier pigeons only. JK, we use Slack.

LEADERSHIP: We expect our leaders to be guiding lights for their teams. To support that, we provide leadership courses to sharpen their leadership abilities, including an in-house leadership coach.

AUTONOMY: We practice autonomy, empowerment, and accountability so that every team member can be in control of their own life.

• HYBRID WORKING: This role is required to be in our Inglewood office every Tuesday and Thursday with the occasional third day thrown in.

• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: We have an all-company learning program so that we’re constantly leveling up our skills.

SUSTAINABILITY: We think Earth’s pretty rad. That’s why we take action wherever possible to limit our impact on the planet.

• 1% FOR THE PLANET MEMBER: 1% of goodr’s annual sales go directly to environmental organizations.

• CARBON NEUTRAL: In 2019, goodr became a 100% carbon neutral company.

Fun Fact: goodr celebrates every Earth Day by releasing limited-edition sunglasses with frames made from 100% recycled materials—and the packaging is 100% sustainable, too!

ABOUT THE ROLE

When others see numbers, you see the story behind them. You’re the kind of leader who can turn ambiguity into a clear financial roadmap… and make it actionable! Forecasts don’t scare you, endless scenarios excite you, and you’re always thinking three steps ahead.

As our Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Business Intelligence, you’ll own company-wide planning, forecasting, and long-range strategy, delivering insights that guide leadership decisions and fuel smart growth. You’ll partner closely with teams across the business to connect performance to strategy, model what’s next, and help goodr invest in the right opportunities at the right time.

If you love big-picture thinking, sharp analysis, and using data to shape the future, keep reading!

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide clear insights into business performance and key financial metrics

• Partner with our Controller and other key role holders to interpret financial results and support strategic decision-making

• Oversee cash flow management, working capital strategy, and liquidity planning to ensure financial health and flexibility

• Lead company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning of both revenue, demand, and expenses in collaboration with department leaders

• Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of FP&A and business intelligence analysts, establishing scalable processes and ensuring strict accuracy across all financial outputs

• Identify strategic and operational financial risks and opportunities, providing proactive, forward-looking recommendations

• Provide detailed financial modeling and scenario planning for key initiatives, M&A opportunities, and capital allocation decisions

• Own the Budget vs. Actuals (BvA) process, partnering with department leaders across all teams to understand operational velocity and OPEX movement

• Deliver high-impact executive presentations, narrative-driven storytelling, and board/investor-level reporting

• Build and manage a high-performing team while partnering across functions to ensure financial alignment

• This role is in the Money department and will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer

• Perform other related duties as assigned

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead by example by consistently living into goodr’s values of Fun and Authenticity

• Be a culture carrier by leaning into our three fundamentals of communication, professionalism, and vision

• Hold monthly one-on-ones with each team member to build upon their role duties and hold everyone accountable

• Ask clear questions, increase everyone’s knowledge, and empower the team so that we can get the best out of every person in your department

• Give consistent, continuous feedback and challenge your flock to perpetually grow so they become the best version of themselves

• Own your team’s budget and ensure its accuracy

• Use imagination and wisdom to set team goals and communicate them clearly

• Challenge the status quo ALWAYS; the phrase “this is how we’ve always done it” is banned here at goodr, so don’t be afraid to push out of your comfort zone and encourage your team to do the same

ABOUT THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

• May or may not have a degree...we don’t care (bonus points for Basset Hound Science or Dinosaur Law)

• 7+ years of financial planning and analysis experience with 4+ yrs of experience as a Director

• Deep understanding of both financial & accounting principles

• Ability to develop financial strategies that align with company goals

• Effectively communicating financial information to senior management

• Expert level in Microsoft Excel

• Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Planning (Adaptive Insights)

• Understanding of coding languages and analytical models (SQL, Python, data warehouses, machine learning models)

• Knowledge of ERP systems (we use Netsuite!)

• Experience with Figma is a HUGE plus!

• Proven experience leading financial reporting, budgeting/forecasting, and long-range planning

• Has an in-depth understanding of team dynamics

• Experience in a scaling or high-growth environment

• Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills

• Strong communicator who lives into collaboration

• Driven by personal growth and thrives in an environment of constant feedback

• Is proactive and an independent problem solver! (Can you google a question?)

WHAT YOU GET

• A role at a company that is going to the moon

• The opportunity to show up every day and have fun

• The ability to learn and grow as a person

• Paid vacation (we encourage you to take time off!)

• Paycheck... obviously. Salary range: $180-$200k, final offer will be made within this range based on experience

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401(K) with company matching

• Financial Wellness Counseling

• Sunglasses. Obviously.

**No Visa Sponsorship is available for this position.

NEXT STEPS

Here's what we expect the hiring process for this role to be, should all go well with your candidacy. This entire process is expected to take 8 weeks to complete and you'd be expected to start on a specific date.

1. Application

2. Fill out a form with basic questions

3. 30 minute introductory interview with HR team member

4. 30 minute virtual interviews with peers and manager

5. Final assignment and presentation

6. Offer!

TO GET THE PROCESS STARTED, REVIEW & SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING:

• Review goodr's Applicant Privacy Policy. By submitting an application to goodr, you are confirming that you have read the Applicant Privacy Policy and agree to its terms. (Because nothing says “fun” like reading legal documents!)

• Resume

• Links to projects or groups you’re involved with (if you have them)

• A drawing of an octopus fighting a pirate (not joking)*

• We may ask you to enter a code. But don't worry, it's just our attempt to keep the bots at bay.

*We accept submissions using accessibility tools.

goodr is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application, interview, or hiring process, please contact us at accommodations@goodr.com so we can discuss appropriate accommodations.

About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences. Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

The Role

We are hiring Sales Development Representatives to build the pipeline behind HeyGen's next phase of growth. This is a full-funnel prospecting role with a heavy emphasis on outbound. You will research target accounts, run creative outbound campaigns, work product-led signals, qualify interest, and book first meetings for our Account Executives. This is not a traditional SDR role where you work someone else's list and a fixed script. We are looking for hunters who are comfortable moving fast, testing new outbound ideas, starting conversations with busy buyers, and earning meetings through persistence, creativity, and sharp research. You will prospect into companies using HeyGen's web app and API, helping buyers see how AI video can transform marketing, sales enablement, customer education, training, localization, product onboarding, and developer-powered video workflows.

What You'll Do

Build pipeline from scratch - You will run high-volume, high-quality outbound into target accounts. This includes cold email, phone, LinkedIn, personalized video, account research, trigger-based outreach, and creative campaign ideas. You should be excited by the idea of starting conversations that would not have happened without you.

Mine product-led signals - You will work with self-serve users, product usage data, sign-ups, and inbound interest to find the teams already getting value from HeyGen who are ready for a bigger conversation.

Qualify with discipline - You will run first conversations that uncover real pain, identify who owns the budget, and understand timing, so every meeting you book is one an Account Executive wants to take.

Sell the outcome, not just the meeting - You will help prospects see how HeyGen can reduce video production costs, speed up content creation, improve localization, personalize customer communication, and unlock new video workflows, so they show up to the first call already curious.

Move fast and test - You will try new messaging, channels, personas, and sequences, measure what works, and share it with the team. Most experiments fail; the ones that work become the playbook.

Partner with Account Executives - You will align with AEs on target accounts, share what you are hearing in the market, and hand off the context they need to run a strong first meeting.

Maintain strong pipeline discipline - You will keep CRM data clean, log activity accurately, and understand the difference between a real opportunity and a polite maybe.

What We're Looking For

• 1+ years of experience in sales, business development, or another target-driven role.

• A track record of meeting or exceeding activity, meeting, or pipeline targets.

• Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

• Strong discovery instincts and the ability to find a real business problem in a first conversation.

• Comfort reaching out to marketing, sales, customer success, L&D, product, operations, founder, or technical stakeholders.

• A high-agency, builder mindset. You do not wait for perfect playbooks. You test, learn, and iterate.

• Strong written communication skills. Your cold emails and follow-ups should be clear, short, and get replies.

• Curiosity about AI, video, creative workflows, and API-driven products.

Nice-to-Haves

• SDR or BDR experience at a PLG, usage-based, API, creative software, marketing technology, sales technology, or AI company.

• Experience prospecting into marketing, localization, customer education, learning and development, sales enablement, ecommerce, media, or product teams.

• Experience using video, personalization, AI tools, or creative outbound to start conversations.

• Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.

Who Will Thrive Here

• Gets energy from prospecting and hunting.

• Can write a sharp cold email without waiting for marketing to give you a template.

• Is comfortable making calls, sending videos, testing messaging, and following up persistently.

• Treats a target as a game to win, not a burden.

• Does not need a fully built sales playbook to be productive.

• Wants to become a top-performing Account Executive and is willing to earn it.

• Is competitive, resourceful, and organized.

• Knows how to balance volume with thoughtful qualification.

Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive base salary plus variable pay.

• Equity in a high-growth AI company.

• Health, dental, and vision benefits.

• Flexible PTO.

• A clear path into a closing Account Executive role.

• High ownership, high velocity, and direct impact on revenue growth.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer on the Sentry products team, you will work inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality and reliable products for Anduril's Sentry autonomous surveillance systems and the critical components that make successful sourcing solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, quality, and performance of components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's core commodity families — PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging — that enable Sentry to operate in demanding field environments. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers, and partnering with them for world-class results is essential across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing across multiple commodity types, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria and metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout the product development stages with the Sentry product engineering team through design reviews, supplier process development, testing, and qualification for components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's commodity families: PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging. Review supplier processes and capabilities to ensure alignment to product, part, and sub-assembly requirements.

• Provide technical expertise for manufacturing and outsourcing processes across commodities — including printed circuit board assemblies, structural and power systems, radar modules, and imaging sensor assemblies. Drive the gathering of data and insights from suppliers to conduct top-tier evaluations of manufacturability, quality, cost-efficiency, capability, and audit compliance.

• Partner with development engineering (mechanical, electrical, RF, and optical/systems), product quality engineering, and program management to deliver predictable supply to Sentry development programs and production programs, and manage exceptions, containments, and deviations for supplier technical performance.

• Drive supplier quality readiness by analyzing key and critical characteristics for drawings, schematics, and supplier specifications, develop measurement systems and inspection criteria, and lead supplier qualification activities (PPAP, FAIR, MSA, Audit, inspection development, PFMEA & AS9102, etc.).

• Partner with Category Management and Sourcing Engineering to drive overall supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and fulfillment of strategic goals across all four commodity families.

• Own the elimination of supplier risk to improve quality and reliability across the Sentry product lifecycle, from early prototyping through scaled production. Utilize audits, readiness reviews, and training and documentation to ensure compliance.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the technology/vendor capability roadmap and delivery schedules needed for future Sentry variants, proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and explorations.

• Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) and Material Review Board (MRB) activities. Review supplier effectiveness of actions and share lessons learned across the Sentry product team. Drive supplier corrective action and response (SCAR) process.

• Audit the Quality Management System at our suppliers as it pertains to supplier quality and performance. Define and improve required documentation and activities as needed to ensure Anduril's compliance to flow-down requirements from customers.

• Prepare, support, and lead supplier onsite audits and reviews for contract deliverables for quality management and compliance.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar technical field (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred)

• Experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in aerospace/defense or similar hardware across one or more of the following commodities: PCBA, structures and power, radar, or imaging

• Experience driving high quality assembly and/or disassembly of complex projects and mechanical or electronic structures through developing drawings, schematics, and work instructions with other engineering functions

• Experience with driving supplier performance and evaluation. Experience with Statement of Work (SOW), quality clauses, intellectual property (IP), and government regulations such as ITAR, etc.

As the architect of inventory planning, you will build out the function, strategies, processes, tools, and team needed to support and scale Poshmark. This role reports to the VP of Merchandising.

Responsibilities

 - Partner with Merchandising on store allocations and the timing of new product launches.

Inventory Strategy & Open-to-Buy

 - Create and run weekly category- and brand-level reporting to drive deeper merchandising insights.

 - Develop a markdown cadence, and identify and resolve inventory gluts.

Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Partner with the Data Analytics and Tech teams to develop and implement an inventory tracking and forecasting system.

 - Collaborate with Merchandising, Store Operations, and Finance to align inventory strategy with business priorities.

 - Represent the planning function to senior leadership, clearly communicating inventory position, risks, and opportunities.

Requirements

 - 3+ years of experience at the senior manager level or above in retail inventory planning or management.

 - Experience building merchandise planning and inventory management tools and processes from the ground up.

 - Experience consolidating data sources into clear, actionable insights.

 - Experience working with distribution center operations and retail store allocation.

 - Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable plans.

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate needs, and build frameworks independently.

 - Experience in multi-category retail or DTC environments preferred.
